1.goRes: Somewhere down the hall a ghost cheers. Ines, flushed and fierce, throws a pinch of salt over her shoulder without looking, and keeps her eyes on him.
1.waitRes: "Right. Yes. Ghost." She scrambles up, brushing at her knees and refusing to meet his eyes, ears red. "Patrol continues. Separately. Don't say anything to Vesper."

3.title: Salt Circle
3.text: The floorboards around Sam's bed are scattered with a neat white ring of salt, and Ines kneels in the middle of it with the pouch in her fist, candlelight flickering over her black bob and her silver earrings. She looks very serious, in the way she does when she is hiding nerves. "Protection," she says. Then she steps inside it, closing the last gap with her hand, and her grin turns sly. "Nobody gets in or out till morning."

image.comp: kneeling inside a circle of salt around a bed, holding a salt pouch, sly heated grin
image.setting: candlelit manor bedroom, salt circle on the floorboards

3.goRes: Nobody does. A ghost in the wall complains all night, and Ines tells it, breathless and laughing, to mind its own haunting.
3.waitRes: She laughs so hard she scuffs the circle with her knee, shaking out the pouch. "Fine. Bathroom breaks. I'll redraw it next week, and you're holding the salt."

3.title: Rent Is Due
3.text: Her old landlord's office in the Underdistrict hasn't changed: gold coins heaped in dishes, red lamplight, a smell of smoke and cedar. Vharra lounges on a velvet chaise with an enormous ledger across her knees, horns catching the glow, golden piercings gleaming. Sam's name is at the top of the page. She crooks one finger at him and her smile is pure appetite. "You've been living rent-free in my head for weeks," she says. "Rent's due."

image.comp: lounging on a velvet chaise with a huge ledger, crooking a finger at him, greedy delighted smile, horns and gold jewelry
image.setting: opulent underground office, gold coins, red lamplight

3.goRes: Vharra's laugh is low and thoroughly pleased. "Interest accrues from the moment you walked in," she purrs, pulling him down by the lapels, and the ledger slides shut.
3.waitRes: "Everyone does." She taps her pen against her teeth, eyes glittering, and writes something in the margin with a flourish. "Late fee. And I do so enjoy collecting."

1.title: Field Study
1.text: Rhoswen has a leather notebook titled HUMAN CUSTOMS and tonight she holds it open with both hands, silver circlet slightly crooked, her ink-stained fingers trembling. The page says only "Kissing (?)". The room smells of warm tea and ink, and her ears, delicately pointed, are pink to the tips. She keeps her chin high as a court lady should. "I would like to observe this firsthand," she says, pen ready. "For accuracy."

image.comp: holding an open notebook and quill, looking up at him with earnest scholarly curiosity and pink cheeks
image.setting: quiet garden bench at dusk, roses

1.goRes: She forgets to take notes. The pen rolls away across the floor, and when she finally draws back she asks, very quietly and with great dignity, whether the experiment might be repeated.
1.waitRes: "I have read the books." She closes the notebook with a small snap, slightly put out and trying not to show how much. "They were insufficient. I shall make a note of that."

2.title: Further Study
2.text: The notebook has many more pages now, and the corners are soft from handling. Rhoswen hands it to Sam open to a list headed FURTHER QUESTIONS, her handwriting immaculate and a little unsteady. Then she turns to stare very hard at a vase of lilies, spine straight, blushing furiously. The candle gutters and the whole room seems to wait on his answer. "Please," she says to the vase, "take your time."

image.comp: staring hard at a vase while holding out an open notebook to him, ears red to the tips
image.setting: elegant guest room, afternoon light

2.goRes: She has a great many follow-up questions. Some she asks aloud and some she simply asks with her hands, and the notebook is forgotten on the floor, pages fluttering.
2.waitRes: "Of course. Methodology." She underlines something three times with a trembling pen, composed again, though the pink in her ears says otherwise.

3.title: Conclusions
3.text: "I have reached a conclusion," Rhoswen says, in the formal voice she uses when she is most afraid. She closes the notebook for good and sets it carefully on Sam's nightstand, squaring it with the edge. Candlelight turns her silver circlet to a thin halo. Her hands, now empty, don't know what to do with themselves. "The study requires a final experiment. I would like it to be with you."

image.comp: setting a closed notebook on a nightstand, unpinning her elegant hair, calm but blushing
image.setting: his bedroom at night, moonlight

3.goRes: Rhoswen's formal composure dissolves into something startled and shining. "I had expected to feel prepared," she whispers, laughing at herself, and reaches for him.
3.waitRes: "I am never uncertain." A pause, and the faintest wobble. "Ask me again in a week. I shall be quite as certain then, and will have rehearsed less."

1.title: Gossip
1.text: The guild hall is at its busiest, adventurers shouldering through, mugs thumping on the counter, the board rustling with fresh postings. Hanna leans over the reception desk with a pencil behind her ear and a spark in her eyes. "The whole guild thinks we're already together," she says, loudly enough for the nearest table. "I hate being wrong about gossip." Freckles flush across her nose. She grabs Sam by the collar. "So I'm fixing it."

image.comp: grabbing his collar over a guild reception counter, freckled, mischievous grin
image.setting: busy adventurers' guild hall, notice boards, afternoon

1.goRes: Half the guild hall cheers. Somebody at the back wins a bet, and Hanna, pink and triumphant, doesn't let go of his collar for a long moment after.
1.waitRes: "That's the POINT." She lets go, sighing dramatically, but she's smiling, tucking the pencil back. "Fine. Somewhere private. Next time, and no spectators."

2.title: Off the Record
2.text: The records room is all dust and shelves, row on row of guild files tied with string, smelling of old paper. Hanna turns the key in the lock with an exaggerated click and leans back against the door, freckled nose wrinkling. "Nothing that happens in here goes in the files," she says, which is a lie, because she files everything, and they both know it. Her bravado wobbles at the edges and she twists the key ring around her finger.

image.comp: leaning against tall shelves of scrolls in a records room, keys dangling from one finger, playful smile
image.setting: guild records room, shelves of scrolls, a single lamp

2.goRes: Hanna keeps very good notes, and she is delightedly, breathlessly unfiled for once. Sam suspects there will be a folder anyway, labelled something rude.
2.waitRes: "Ugh, PROCEDURE." She unlocks the door with a theatrical groan and a grin. "Fine. You owe me, and I keep very detailed accounts."

3.title: Exclusive
3.text: Hanna kicks her shoes off inside Sam's door and sets them in the corner, one on top of the other, as if she's been doing it for years. Lamplight picks out the freckles across her nose and the way she's chewing her lip. For five years she has had the best gossip in Hollowmere, and for once she's quiet. "I've had the best gossip in town for five years," she says. "Tonight I'd like an exclusive."

image.comp: kicking off her shoes in a bedroom, freckled, grinning and a little nervous
image.setting: his bedroom at night, lamplight

3.goRes: She doesn't tell a soul. Everyone knows by lunchtime anyway, but for the night itself Hanna is quiet and soft and entirely his.
3.waitRes: "Embargoed!" She laughs, a little shaky, and puts her shoes back on. "Fine. One week. Then it goes to print, and the headline is yours."

1.title: Clear Skies
1.text: Her grounded skyship sits on the cliff edge, timbers silvered by weather, and at sunset the whole deck glows copper. Rinna leads Sam up the gangway, tail swishing, small horns catching the light, the wind tugging at her captain's hat. She leans on the rail with a salt-rough grin. "Sixty years flying, and I never once kissed anyone on deck," she says. "Bad luck for sailors. But we're not flying." She holds his gaze.

image.comp: on the deck of a grounded wooden skyship at sunset, wind in her hair, pulling him close by his cloak
image.setting: airship deck on a cliff edge at sunset, rigging and clouds

1.goRes: The wind picks up, snapping the old sails above them. Neither of them notices, and her tail curls round his ankle like a rope tied off.
1.waitRes: "Landlubber." She laughs and tosses him a rope to coil, though her ears have flattened, just briefly. "Next clear sky, then, and you'd better not jinx it."

3.title: Shore Leave
3.text: The captain's cabin door bangs open under Rinna's boot, and lantern light spills over chart tables, a salt-stained bunk, and the brass-bound trunk where the hat lives. The wreck groans softly around them, wind in the hull. Rinna props herself in the doorway, tail lashing, coppery scales glinting, grin wide and a little nervous. "Shore leave," she says. "Captain's orders. You're coming aboard."

image.comp: standing in the doorway of a captain's cabin, coat thrown over her shoulder, wolfish grin
image.setting: cozy wooden captain's cabin with a hammock and charts, lamplight

3.goRes: Rinna whoops, and then, more softly, hauls him in by the hoodie and presses her forehead to his. "Welcome aboard, Sam. Mind the beam, it's seen worse."
3.waitRes: "It's on a CLIFF." She cackles, slapping the doorframe, then ruffles his hair. "Next week. Bring a bucket, and I'll bring the rum."

2.title: The Tide Pool
2.text: The lowest pool in the Pearl Grotto glows a soft pale blue, the walls crusted with pearls that breathe light in the steam. The air smells of salt and warm stone. Maris kneels at the edge, long ears hung with pearl earrings trembling, and takes Sam's hand and guides it into the water, which is warmer than it should be. "Some things are easier to say without words," she murmurs, and doesn't say anything else for a long time.

image.comp: in a glowing tide pool in a sea cave, guiding his hand into the luminous water, half-lidded serene smile
image.setting: sea cave grotto lit by glowing pearls and luminous water

2.goRes: The pearls dim, very slowly, as if they are being polite. Maris's smile is the first unguarded thing he has ever seen on her.
2.waitRes: "Older than your questions." She smiles and lets go of his hand, water running from her fingers. "Come back when you're ready to stop asking. The pool will keep."

3.title: High Tide
3.text: Once a year the grotto floods to its ceiling with light, the tide lifting every pearl in the walls until the whole cavern shimmers like the inside of a shell. Maris waits on the pearl-crusted ledge, hair damp, the water lapping at her ankles and humming faintly of salt. She does not smile when she says it. "Once a year," she says. "I've never wanted to share it before."

image.comp: waiting on a pearl-crusted ledge above glowing floodwater, holding out her hand to him
image.setting: flooded sea cave at high tide, glowing water and pearls everywhere

3.goRes: The tide goes out at dawn. So, eventually, do they. Maris leaves one pearl in his palm without a word.
3.waitRes: "Next year, then." She doesn't sound disappointed. She sounds like someone who has learned to wait, and the light on her face is soft and unhurried.

1.title: The Longest Pause
1.text: Lara is sorting linen in the quiet of the back room when Sam comes in, the lamp low, the shelves smelling of lavender and clean cotton. She keeps her eyes on the pillowcases, folding the same one twice. Her plum lipstick is bitten at one edge, her silver nose stud catching the light. "I've thought about this for a very long time," she says, "and I'm very frightened, and I'd like to anyway." She sets the linen down and looks up at him.

image.comp: standing close to him in a linen room, hands trembling slightly, looking up with shy resolve, lips parted
image.setting: lamp-lit linen room at night

1.goRes: The kiss is soft and unsteady, and then not unsteady at all. She keeps her hand on his collar after, as though he might be one more thing that can be taken away, and he stays still to show it isn't.
1.waitRes: She exhales, half relief, half disappointment, and nods. "Thank you for asking. That helps more than you know."

2.title: Lamp Out
2.text: For once Lara turns the courtyard lamp off herself. The courtyard falls to starlight and the soft sound of crickets, and her black dress melts into the night so that only her face and her pale hands are visible. "I don't need it to find you," she says, small voice, steady hands. "I'd like to try, if you're willing, going somewhere together without it." She takes his hand, her fingers cold and then not.

image.comp: holding his hand in a dark doorway, a single candle behind her, shy and brave
image.setting: his doorway at night, candlelight

2.goRes: The door closes behind them. What they find in the dark is gentle and slow and kind, and Lara laughs once, quietly, surprised at herself.
2.waitRes: "Another night," she repeats, as if testing the weight of it. She smiles. It holds, and so does her hand in his for a breath longer.

3.title: Staying
3.text: Lara is waiting in Sam's room in a long black nightdress, hair down for once, the ponytail ribbon twisted in her fingers. The lamp is turned low, and she stands in its small circle with her chin lifted and her knuckles pale. Her plum lipstick is gone. "If I stay tonight," she says, "I want it to be because I want to. Not because I'm afraid to be in my own room alone." She sets the ribbon on his table.

image.comp: standing by his bed with her long dark hair loose, holding a black ribbon, looking steadily at him
image.setting: his bedroom, moonlight through the window

3.goRes: The lamp goes out. In the morning she wakes before him and, for the first time, isn't afraid of the quiet, and lies listening to him breathe.
3.waitRes: "I'm sure," she says softly. "But I can wait until you are." She picks up the ribbon and leaves, steady on her feet.

1.title: No Longer Typing
1.text: Emily has been typing-indicator nervous all evening: starting sentences, abandoning them, starting again, her grey tail twitching with every false start. Finally she sets down her notebook and pushes her round glasses up her nose. "I've wanted to do this since about year four," she says. "I never said, because it was a forum. And then because it was you." Before he can answer she has stepped close, ears flat, tail coiled, and kissed him like she's afraid the connection will drop.

image.comp: standing close to him having just kissed him, glasses askew, notebook in hand, ears flat, tail coiled, blushing
image.setting: quiet lounge after close, lamplight

1.goRes: He does, and her tail starts to thump against the bookshelf behind her. Her glasses end up somewhere on the floor. Neither of them looks for them, and she is smiling too much to kiss properly.
1.waitRes: "Oh. Oh." She steps back, ears pinned, tail wrapped around her knees. "That's fine. That's totally fine. Message received. Retrying later." She smiles shakily, and means the second part.

3.title: Log Off Together
3.text: Emily knocks on Sam's door at midnight in her oversized hoodie, hood up so only the grey wolf ears show, tail trailing behind her over the threshold. The hallway lamp makes a halo of her glasses. "We used to say goodnight and then keep talking for three more hours," she says. "I don't want to say goodnight through a door anymore." She pushes the hood back and steps inside.

image.comp: standing in his doorway at midnight in an oversized hoodie with the hood half down over her wolf ears, resolute and shy
image.setting: his bedroom doorway, lamp glow

3.goRes: The door closes. Nobody says goodnight for a long, long time, and no one reaches for the lamp either.
3.waitRes: "gn," she says, ears drooping and rising again. "But I'm not logging off for good."

1.title: Return to Sender
1.text: Lirael hands Sam an envelope with nothing written on it, her hand quite steady and her ears not. Inside is a single line in her small, careful script: "I've wanted to do this since the second letter." The sorting room smells of paper and sealing wax. Before he has finished reading, she has stepped close, her round spectacles slightly fogged, the tips of her ears pink, and kissed him as carefully as she seals an envelope.

image.comp: standing close to him having just kissed him, an unmarked envelope in her hand, the tips of her ears pink, blushing
image.setting: post house back room, shelves of letters

1.goRes: He does, and her elbow knocks against the shelves, scattering letters across the floor. Neither of them looks down.
1.waitRes: "Oh. Oh." She steps back, ears dipping. "I'll mark it 'undelivered' and try again later." She smiles shakily, and tucks the envelope back in her sleeve.

3.title: Special Delivery
3.text: Lirael knocks on Sam's door at midnight, satchel on her shoulder, a ribbon of silver threaded through her hair. The hall smells faintly of ink and rain. She holds the strap with both hands. "I have something for you. It was addressed to you ten years ago. It has taken me this long to deliver it." She sets the satchel down by the door, the buckles clinking, and steps inside.

image.comp: standing in his doorway at midnight with a letter satchel over her shoulder, silver ribbon in her hair, resolute and shy
image.setting: his bedroom doorway, lamp glow

3.goRes: The door closes. Whatever she brought, he accepts it, and signs for it gladly, and she is laughing against his shoulder.
3.waitRes: "Of course." She smiles, ears dipping and lifting again. "But I'm not taking it back."

1.title: Point of Order
1.text: Ella calls an emergency staff meeting, takes the head of the table, and then dismisses everyone but Sam. The room empties in a rustle of chairs; her gaze, perfectly level, never leaves him. "I propose an amendment," she says, sliding the agenda aside with one finger. "That we stop pretending this isn't happening." She takes his lapel and kisses him as precisely as she does everything else, then steps back, hands folded, for his response.

image.comp: holding the front of his jacket, having just kissed him, composed and flushed, an agenda in her other hand
image.setting: empty meeting room, lamplight, papers on the table

1.goRes: He does. She notes, afterward and a little breathless, that he has scored very highly in the category she just invented.
1.waitRes: "Tabled," she says, adjusting her cuffs with flawless composure, though a faint colour has risen at her throat. "Until the next session. Don't be late."

3.title: Final Round
3.text: Ella is waiting in Sam's room with a chessboard set up between two glasses of wine, the firelight picking out the ivory. "Winner chooses," she says. The board is nearly cleared; one move remains. She turns her king over with one finger before he can reach for his piece. "I forfeit." For once her perfectly level gaze wavers. She holds out her hand.

image.comp: standing beside a chessboard with a toppled king, one hand extended toward him, bright blue eyes steady
image.setting: his bedroom, candlelight, chessboard on a low table

3.goRes: The door closes. By her own later assessment, there are no losers, and she is not in the least sorry about the king.
3.waitRes: "Coward," she says fondly. She sets the king back upright. "One more game, then. I will win."

1.title: Observation
1.text: Ione stops beside Sam at the bar after closing, glasses polished and lamps low, her status light glowing a thoughtful gold at her temple. "I have observed that I enjoy looking at you," she says clinically. "I have a hypothesis that doing something about that would be pleasant. May I test it?" She does not wait for permission. She kisses him once, carefully, and holds still afterward to take measurements.

image.comp: leaning close to him having just kissed him, head tilted with scientific curiosity and a flush of gold at her temple
image.setting: inn bar after closing, bottles gleaming

1.goRes: He kisses her back. Her status light flares gold. "Confirmed," she whispers, wonderingly. "Repeat."
1.waitRes: "Of course," she says. "I am very patient. It is, in fact, my principal feature." Her light is still gold.

3.title: Unlogged
3.text: Ione waits in Sam's room, sitting on the edge of the bed with perfect posture, hands in her lap, the Lantern Keeper's diary closed on the table. Her status light glows soft gold against the dark. "I have disabled the archive," she says. "Everything that happens tonight is unlogged. Mine only." She holds out her hand. "I would like this one to be mine."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of his bed with her hand held out to him, silver hair catching candlelight, a steady gold glow at her temple
image.setting: his bedroom, candlelight

3.goRes: The light goes out. In the morning she tells him it is the only memory she hopes never to lose.
3.waitRes: "The archive can wait," she says. "The pause is not data I mind keeping." She leaves her hand on his for a moment longer.

1.title: A Matter of Plumage
1.text: Anael finds Sam in the courtyard at dusk and, without a word, opens one great white wing and folds it gently around his shoulders. It is warm, and smells of rain and lamp smoke. "It is a gesture of protection among my order," she says, very correct. "It is also, I am told, a gesture of something else." She leans in and kisses him, softly, and her halo brightens until the courtyard glows.

image.comp: enfolding him with one white wing, leaning in to kiss him, halo glowing, eyes closed
image.setting: lantern-lit courtyard at dusk

1.goRes: He kisses her back. The lanterns along the wall flare gold, one after another, and neither notices.
1.waitRes: "Of course." The wing withdraws, tenderly, and her halo dims to a patient glow. "I have waited three hundred years. A little longer is no burden."

3.title: Lamp Out
3.text: Anael is waiting in Sam's room with the window open, night air stirring the curtains and her wings folded close behind her. A single lamp burns on the table. "The Order lights a lantern for each soul it watches over," she says. "This one is for you." She cups the flame, and with a breath, blows it out. The halo is the only light left. "I will not be watching tonight. Only with you."

image.comp: standing at his window in a soft white gown, wings half-open, a single lamp cupped in her hands
image.setting: his bedroom at night, an open window, moonlight

3.goRes: The room goes dark and warm. In the morning there are white-gold feathers on the floor, and she does not tidy them.
3.waitRes: "As you wish." She relights it with a touch and settles in the chair, wings gently folded. "I will wait."

1.title: Pressed Flowers
1.text: Hinata has been pressing flowers from the garden between the pages of the house ledger, and tonight she finally brings the finished book to Sam's door. "I made this for you," she says, then stops, starts again, stops. Her fingers are twisted together at her waist. "I-I've practiced saying something else for three days. It all went away. So... may I kiss you instead?"

image.comp: standing in a doorway holding a small book to her chest, cheeks flushed, pale lavender eyes lifted bravely to him
image.setting: hallway outside his room, soft lantern light, a vase of garden flowers

1.goRes: She rises on tiptoe, trembling, and the kiss is soft and brief and entirely sincere. When she pulls back she's smiling like she just won something.
1.waitRes: Hinata exhales, half relieved, half sorry. "Y-yes. Of course. I will... I will try again, with better words." She bows, and the book stays in his hands.

2.title: Hands That Stopped Shaking
2.text: They are folding linens in the storeroom after closing when Hinata's hand rests over Sam's and stays there. "I used to freeze whenever I wanted something," she says, very quietly. "At home, wanting things was not allowed. I want to touch you, Sam. Properly. If you'll let me lead, I think I can do it without fainting."

image.comp: sitting among stacked linens, her hand resting over his, a nervous determined smile, blushing to the ears
image.setting: quiet linen storeroom, one lantern, shelves of folded towels

2.goRes: Her hands are cool, then warm, then sure. Somewhere in the middle she laughs at herself, and it's the nicest sound he has heard all week.
2.waitRes: She nods quickly, ears red. "Th-thank you for telling me honestly. That... helps more than you know." She finishes the linens twice as fast as usual.

3.title: The Room She Chose
3.text: Hinata knocks, waits exactly four breaths, and enters with her hair loose. "I walked away from a house with a hundred rooms," she says. "I wanted one room of my own, and one person I chose." Her voice cracks on the last word, but her eyes don't leave his. "Would you stay with me tonight? I'm very afraid. I'm also very sure."

image.comp: sitting at the edge of a bed in a plain nightgown, hair loose, hands folded, gazing at him steadily with shy resolve
image.setting: her small tidy room, one candle, a window open to the night garden

3.goRes: He sits beside her, and she leans into his shoulder like a door finally swinging open. The candle burns low and neither of them mentions it.
3.waitRes: "I am ready," Hinata whispers, and then, smiling through embarrassment: "But I think I would like to hear you say you'll wait anyway." He says it, and she squeezes his hand.

jump.title: All at Once
jump.text: Hinata has been quietly working herself ragged for weeks, and tonight something in her simply gives. She finds Sam on the back steps, takes his face in both hands, and kisses him before the stammer can start. "I decided," she breathes, "that being brave once is easier than being nervous forever. Please do not let me regret it."

image.comp: holding his face in both hands, eyes wide with her own boldness, blushing deeply, hair falling forward
image.setting: back steps of the house, moonlight, crickets in the garden

jump.goRes: He does, and she melts so completely he has to catch her. "Oh," she says into his hoodie. "That was much better than the practicing."
jump.waitRes: She blinks, realizes what she's done, and goes scarlet. "I... I will apologize in a few minutes, when my face stops burning." She does not let go of his sleeve.

1.title: Battlefield Manners
1.text: Sakura heals the scrape on Sam's elbow after he walks into a doorframe, glowing hands warm and efficient, and doesn't let go afterwards. "You know," she says, eyes narrowed, "I spent years waiting for a man to find time for me. You find time for everyone in this house. It's infuriating. I'm kissing you now, and you can argue with me after."

image.comp: gripping his wrist with a faint green glow around her hand, defiant half smile, pink hair falling across one eye
image.setting: infirmary corner of the house, white sheets, medicine jars

1.goRes: He doesn't. She kisses like she does everything, fully committed, and ends it a little breathless and a lot pleased with herself.
1.waitRes: "A minute." Sakura rolls her shoulders and smirks, unoffended. "I've waited years. I can survive sixty seconds. But I'm timing you."

2.title: Sparring Partner
2.text: They end up on the training mats after hours, Sakura's wraps half undone, flushed from a bout she let Sam lose on purpose. She pins his wrists above his head, grinning. "Long-distance romance taught me one thing: don't leave it to chance." Her hair is damp, her pulse visible at her throat. "Tell me to stop, or I'm going further."

image.comp: straddling nothing, leaning over him on a training mat with a competitive grin, wraps loose, flushed from exertion
image.setting: empty training yard, lanterns, scuffed mats

2.goRes: She does not stop, and for a good while neither of them keeps score.
2.waitRes: She sits back instantly, still grinning, all the heat folding into respect. "Good. Say it clearly like that and I'll always listen." She helps him up and hits him on the shoulder, gently, which still hurts.

3.title: The Cure for Waiting
3.text: Sakura waits in the infirmary, sleeves rolled, a bottle of plum wine at her elbow. "Everyone I ever loved was far away or busy saving the world," she says. "You're twelve steps from my bed and you spend your nights worrying about me. Please, Sam. Be here. Just be here." It is the softest he has ever heard her, and she hates that it is.

image.comp: sitting on the edge of an infirmary cot with a bottle and two cups, guard lowered, vulnerable half smile
image.setting: infirmary at night, one lamp, herbs hanging to dry

3.goRes: The tough act falls away all at once. She curls against him and the night is long, tender, and entirely unhurried.
3.waitRes: "Ask me one more time and I'll punch a wall," she says, and then laughs and ducks her head. "Fine. Yes, I'm sure. Take the week if you need it."

jump.title: No More Waiting
jump.text: Sakura is done with slow. She drags Sam out of the ledger room mid-sentence, down the corridor, and kisses him against the wall before he can finish a thought. "I counted," she says. "Three hundred and some days of you being kind and doing nothing about it. That's my limit. Fix this."

image.comp: pressing him gently against a corridor wall, one hand flat on the plaster beside his head, fierce and flushed
image.setting: house corridor, wall lantern, wood paneling

jump.goRes: He fixes it, thoroughly and with notes later. Sakura laughs against his mouth, ferociously happy.
jump.waitRes: "Wait?" She rocks back, blinks, then barks a laugh. "Fine, catch your breath. You have until I finish counting to ten." She counts very slowly.

1.title: Free Sample
1.text: Ino sweeps into the lounge with a bouquet and no apology. "You treat everyone here like a person first and staff second, did you know? It's a terrible business plan. I love it." She tucks a flower behind his ear, then leans in with a wicked smile. "Hold still. Compliments are one thing, but I like to deliver the full effect."

image.comp: tucking a flower behind his ear, leaning in close with a teasing smile, flirtatious eyes, long blonde ponytail swinging
image.setting: lantern-lit lounge, vases of cut flowers, evening

1.goRes: She tastes like tea and mischief. When she pulls back she taps his nose. "Not bad, Sam. Not bad at all."
1.waitRes: "Slow? Cute." Ino grins, entirely unbothered. "Anticipation is half the fun, anyway. Think about me tonight."

2.title: Reading You
2.text: Ino reads people for sport, and Sam has been an open book since the day he arrived. She catches him after a long shift and presses a finger to his lips. "Don't talk. You want to ask whether I mean it, and you want to be polite about it." She takes his hand and guides it to her waist. "I mean it. Next question."

image.comp: guiding his hand to her waist with a knowing smirk, one finger raised, bright eyes confident
image.setting: dancers' dressing room, mirrors, hanging silks, warm lamplight

2.goRes: She reads him perfectly, and spends the rest of the night proving it to the very last detail.
2.waitRes: "That I can read too." She pats his cheek, lips curving. "Take your time. I'm very patient when the prize is worth it."

3.title: Last Dance
3.text: Ino finishes the evening show and sends the other dancers home, then locks the stage doors. The house is quiet, the footlights low. "Everyone watches me," she says, unpinning her hair. "Few people see me. You do. So here's an exclusive: just us, no audience." She extends a hand, flushed from the dance, and for once she isn't performing.

image.comp: hand extended toward him, hair half unpinned, glowing from performance, soft real smile for once
image.setting: empty stage, footlights burning low, drawn curtain

3.goRes: She leads. He follows. The curtain stays closed until morning.
3.waitRes: "Oh, honey. I read people for a living, and I'm sure." She softens. "But I like that you asked. Ask me again when you're ready."

jump.title: Cutting the Line
jump.text: Ino has had enough of flirting at him across rooms. She catches him at the card table, sweeps his chips aside, and kisses him in front of three startled regulars. "I fold," she declares to the room. "He's the pot." Then she looks at Sam, a flicker of nerves under all that swagger. "Say something. Quickly."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a card table, one hand on his collar, triumphant grin with a flicker of nerves, chips scattered
image.setting: gaming table room, green felt, scattered cards and coins

jump.goRes: "I raise," Sam manages, and she whoops, kissing him again as the regulars politely applaud.
jump.waitRes: Ino fans herself, laughing. "Fair, fair. I got carried away. We'll take this somewhere with a door." She winks at the regulars. "Show's over, boys."

1.title: Bullseye
1.text: Tenten has pinned every knife she owns into the dartboard behind the bar in a heart shape, then pretends it's a coincidence. "Don't say anything," she warns, leaning over the counter on her elbows. "I spent seventy years being everyone's best friend and tough little sister. I'd like to try being something else. Come here, will you?"

image.comp: leaning across a bar counter toward him, smirking, one knife in her fingers, flushed cheeks, hair in twin buns
image.setting: bar after closing, dartboard with a ring of knives behind her

1.goRes: She kisses him once, quick and bright, like a thrown blade that lands exactly where she wanted.
1.waitRes: "Bit's fine," Tenten says with a lopsided grin, and yanks a knife out of the board. "Just don't take seventy years. I'm a dwarf, not a saint."

2.title: Forge-Warm
2.text: She asks him to hold a piece of steel while she hammers, which is silly because she doesn't need help. Sam holds it anyway, in the little workshop out back, sparks flying, sweat on her collarbone. "My hands are good at making things," Tenten says, setting down the hammer. "I wonder if they're good at other things. Care to find out?"

image.comp: wiping her hands on a leather apron, flushed from the forge heat, teasing eyebrow raised, forge glow on her face
image.setting: back-yard workshop, glowing forge, anvil, scattered tools

2.goRes: Her palms are calloused and unexpectedly gentle. The forge dims to embers while she learns how Sam reacts to a patient hand.
2.waitRes: "Later it is." She smacks his shoulder with a soot-black glove, grinning. "You're on my list. Don't make it a long list."

3.title: Everything on the Table
3.text: Tenten closes the bar and lays out her savings ledger next to a bottle of dwarven whiskey. "Almost enough for the forge," she says. "For years I assumed the next thing I wanted would be an object. Turns out it's a person who hums while he counts coins." She laughs at herself, then goes quiet. "Come upstairs, Sam. I'd like to keep you for the night."

image.comp: sitting on a bed edge with boots off, ledger and whiskey on a nearby chest, grinning shyly, buns coming loose
image.setting: her cozy attic room, slanted ceiling, workbench in the corner

3.goRes: The whiskey stays unopened. She turns out to be very good at holding on to what she values.
3.waitRes: "Dwarves don't sign a contract until we've inspected the goods twice," she says, laughing. "Take your time. I've seen worse deals."

jump.title: Lucky Throw
jump.text: A drunk regular shoves into Sam, and Tenten's knife thuds into the wood an inch from the man's hat. The man leaves. Tenten hops over the bar, shaky with adrenaline. "I don't throw at people I like," she says. "I like you an awful lot. Don't tell anyone how much." Then she grabs him and kisses him hard.

image.comp: hopping over a bar counter, adrenaline flushed, grinning with a knife in one hand, pulling him by the collar
image.setting: bar floor, overturned stool, sawdust, the knife quivering in a post

jump.goRes: Sam's heart is going like a drum, and he kisses her back until neither of them remembers the regular.
jump.waitRes: Tenten winces, then lowers her head. "Right. Sorry. Too much knife." She hands him a drink. "Sit. I'll go slower."

1.title: Terms of Agreement
1.text: Temari drops her fan against the wall of the office with a thud and folds her arms. "I negotiated treaties for three villages. I know a bad bargain and a good one." She nods at him, jaw set. "This is a good one. Do you understand what I'm telling you? Because I will not say it twice." A pause. "I would like to kiss you."

image.comp: arms folded and chin lifted, giving him a stern look softened by a slight blush, large iron fan leaning behind her
image.setting: office after hours, scrolls and treaties spread on the desk

1.goRes: "Terms accepted," he says, and she kisses him with the same precision she brings to everything, then spoils it by smiling.
1.waitRes: Temari raises one brow. "Postponed, not rejected. Very well. I do not rush talks." She picks up her fan. "But I do not forget them, either."

2.title: Desert Wind
2.text: Over wine on the roof, Temari talks about the dunes, how wind there writes new patterns every night and no one can hold onto them. "I've been holding on to everything my whole life. Responsibilities. My brothers. Rules." She looks at him, wind tugging her ponytails. "Tonight I'd like to let go of one. Come closer. That's an order. A polite one."

image.comp: sitting on the roof edge, long blonde ponytails stirring in the breeze, wine cup in hand, soft proud smile
image.setting: moonlit rooftop of the house, rooftops stretching behind her

2.goRes: She sets down the cup and the night wind carries away the sound of every rule she has ever kept.
2.waitRes: "Probably not," Temari concedes, smiling into the wind. "But I am rarely wise after wine. Ask me again sober, and I'll answer better."

3.title: Treaty Signed
3.text: Temari paces her room in a loose robe, which is wildly out of character, and finally stops in front of Sam. "I do not do this casually," she says. "I decided weeks ago. I made a list of reasons. The list became very long." She gives a short, embarrassed laugh. "Stay. I will not ask twice, so please do not make me."

image.comp: standing in a loose robe with hair down for once, arms crossed in self-conscious pride, small blush
image.setting: her tidy room with the iron fan mounted on the wall, warm candlelight

3.goRes: She is as thorough in this as in everything else. Toward dawn she admits, drowsily, that she forgot the list entirely.
3.waitRes: "Understood." She straightens, nods, and for a moment she almost looks relieved. "Then I will be here when you are ready. That is not a threat. It is a promise."

jump.title: Rowdy Client
jump.text: A drunk grabs at a dancer, Temari's fan swings, and the man is suddenly sitting in the street without remembering how. She returns to the doorway with her arms crossed, while Sam stares. "What? Do not look at me like that." Then, quietly: "I would never have done that for just anyone." She grabs his sleeve and kisses him, quick and fierce.

image.comp: pulling him by the sleeve into a quick fierce kiss, other hand resting on her fan, defiant blush
image.setting: front doorway of the house, lantern overhead, night street behind

jump.goRes: She goes still, then softens, and when it ends she mutters something about reflexes. She does not let go of his sleeve.
jump.waitRes: "Yes, yes. Overreaction." She turns, ears pink. "Forget the kiss. Remember the fan." She stalks off, stiff-backed, smiling where he can't see.

1.title: Double or Nothing
1.text: Tsunade slaps a single coin on the bar. "Heads, you kiss me. Tails, I pay your debt interest this week." She flips it, catches it, looks at it, and slides it away without showing him. "I've never lost a bet I cared about," she lies, grinning. Then, more softly, "Sam. I'm rather fond of you. Don't tell my creditors."

image.comp: leaning one elbow on a bar counter, flipping a coin, amused heavy-lidded smile, confident posture
image.setting: private corner table in the bar, dice and cups scattered, lamplight

1.goRes: He kisses her and she laughs into it, delighted. Later he finds the coin: both sides heads.
1.waitRes: Tsunade blinks, then barks a laugh and ruffles his hair. "Hah! Fair. Kid, you might be the only honest man in this town."

2.title: Healer's Touch
2.text: Sam strains his back lifting crates, and Tsunade insists on treating it. Her hands are warm, certain, a century and a half of skill. "Lie down." Then, after a pause that is neither medical nor professional: "Relax. I'm only going to help you feel better. But I might get carried away." Her voice has dropped, a mischievous lilt.

image.comp: kneeling over him with warm glowing palms on his back, amused knowing smile, golden eyes soft
image.setting: healing room, rolled towels, sake bottle on the sill, afternoon light

2.goRes: Her hands start with muscle and wander toward mischief. It is the best medical care he has ever received.
2.waitRes: "Probably not." Tsunade smirks, sits back, and finishes the treatment properly. "I'm taking a rain check, though. Don't you dare forget."

3.title: Winning Hand
3.text: Tsunade finally stops drinking and gambling long enough to be sincere. "Everyone I ever loved died on a battlefield," she says, pouring one cup of sake instead of two. "I told myself I'd never do that again. But you keep showing up, Sam. Like it costs nothing. Stay with me tonight. I want to try again, just once, against the odds."

image.comp: sitting on a futon with a single sake cup, vulnerable honest smile, loose hair, lamplight on her face
image.setting: her private suite, futon, scrolls, warm lamp

3.goRes: The legendary gambler lays down her whole hand, and for once she doesn't bluff.
3.waitRes: "Ha. Cautious kid." She pats his cheek, eyes soft. "Of course I'm sure. But go ahead. Make me wait. I'm the one who taught patience to half of this continent."

jump.title: Sudden Bonus
jump.text: Tsunade wins big at dice for the first time in her life and, euphoric, drags Sam into the hall for a celebratory kiss. "I'm lucky tonight! I'm irresistible!" Then she freezes and realizes she means the second part. "Well," she says, flushed. "That's inconvenient. I might actually like you."

image.comp: holding a fistful of coins aloft, laughing, her other hand gripping his hoodie, flushed with winnings
image.setting: hall outside the gambling room, spilled coins, lantern light

jump.goRes: He does, thoroughly, and she forgets the winnings on the floor. Even Tonton, wandering past, looks scandalized.
jump.waitRes: "A little." Tsunade grins, unabashed. "But the feeling's older than the sake. Ask me tomorrow, sober." She collects her coins, whistling.

1.title: Balanced Books
1.text: Shizune presents Sam with the monthly accounts, perfectly balanced, and a pot of tea she brewed without asking. Tonton snuffles at his feet. "I spent twenty years cleaning up after someone," she says. "You never once asked me to. May I..." She stops, flustered. "May I thank you in a less formal way?"

image.comp: standing by a desk with a tray of tea, bashful smile, short dark hair tucked behind her ear, tiny pig at her feet
image.setting: office, neat ledgers, tea steaming, a small pig underfoot

1.goRes: She kisses him very softly, as though checking each column twice. Tonton, offended, leaves the room.
1.waitRes: "Of course." Shizune bows, pink to the ears. "Please forget I said anything. No, don't forget. Just... carry it for a while."

2.title: Lamp Oil
2.text: Working late on the quarterly budget, Shizune's tea has gone cold and her shoulders have tightened. Sam offers to rub them. She goes rigid, then melts. "Modest women are allowed to want things," she murmurs. "Even when we spend our lives being the reliable one. Please... don't stop. And perhaps a little lower."

image.comp: sitting at a desk with ledgers pushed aside, eyes closed, shoulders loosening, shy blush
image.setting: office at night, candle burning low, stacks of paper

2.goRes: He doesn't. Her quiet sighs are more eloquent than any speech, and the accounts stay unfinished until morning.
2.waitRes: "I'm... not used to being thanked this way." Shizune smiles, flustered. "Another night, perhaps? Let me get used to the idea." She reaches for her pen with trembling fingers.

3.title: Off the Record
3.text: Shizune puts out the lamp in the office and does not light another. "I kept my feelings out of the records my whole life," she says in the dark. "They never fit in a column." Her hand finds his. "I want to be on someone's side of the ledger for once. Yours, if you'll have me. Tonight, and quietly."

image.comp: sitting close beside him in the dim office, hand over his, serious soft expression, blushing
image.setting: office after the lamp is out, moonlight through the window

3.goRes: "You're already on my side," he tells her, and she makes a sound close to a sob and a laugh, and leans in.
3.waitRes: "Yes." She swallows, nodding. "But I understand if you'd rather ask again tomorrow. I will be here, Sam. I am always here."

jump.title: Tonton Approves
jump.text: Tonton squeals in delight when Sam walks in, and Shizune, who has been dithering for weeks, bursts out laughing. "He has opinions about everyone," she says. "He likes you." She kneels beside the piglet, looks up, and says in a rush, "I would also like to say that I like you. Very much. Please excuse the abruptness." She kisses him before she can lose her nerve.

image.comp: kneeling beside a small pig then rising to kiss him quickly, startled at her own boldness, hands clasped
image.setting: small side parlor, sunlit rug, a piglet at her feet

jump.goRes: He kisses her back and she nearly drops the teapot. Tonton squeals again, which is somehow encouraging.
jump.waitRes: "I know." Shizune covers her face. "I'm sorry. Please... let me make a pot of tea and start over." She doesn't leave the room.

1.title: Fifteen Years
1.text: Kurenai sits on the veranda with a cup of tea gone cold, watching the rain. "I buried a husband and raised a child's worth of other people's worries," she says, not looking at Sam. "Nobody asks me what I want." The crimson eyes finally turn to him. "You do. That is a rare thing. May I? Just once?"

image.comp: seated on a veranda with a teacup, long dark hair, crimson eyes turning to him, gentle melancholy smile
image.setting: veranda in soft rain, paper lanterns glowing

1.goRes: The kiss is slow and a little sad and then, unexpectedly, not sad at all. She laughs under her breath and wipes at one eye.
1.waitRes: "Time." Kurenai smiles faintly. "I have been giving that away to everyone else for years. I can spare a little more for myself."

2.title: Illusion, Dissolved
2.text: Kurenai spins a lazy illusion for Sam: cherry blossoms drifting through the empty lounge, petals landing in his hair. "A trick," she says. "I know every trick. What I never learned was how to stop pretending I don't want what's in front of me." The petals fade. Her hand rests lightly on his chest. "There. No illusion. Just me."

image.comp: standing in a swirl of drifting blossoms, one hand on his chest, crimson eyes serious and warm
image.setting: empty lounge, faint illusory cherry blossoms, lantern light

2.goRes: The blossoms return, then the lantern goes out, and for a while neither of them can tell what is real. The warmth, at least, is.
2.waitRes: "Ah." The petals vanish gently. "You are kinder than most men. Another time, then. I'll wait. I am practiced at it."

3.title: The Longest Night
3.text: She chooses the evening carefully: rain, quiet house, a pot of her late husband's favorite tea going untouched. "I've loved one man," Kurenai says. "I never thought there would be another, and I'm not asking you to replace him." She takes Sam's hand. "I'm asking you to be here with me. I have been alone a very long time."

image.comp: sitting on a bed with tea untouched on the table, offering her hand, crimson eyes shining
image.setting: her elegant room, rain on the shutters, one candle

3.goRes: He sits, holds her hand, and when the candle burns low she leans in. The rain goes on a long time.
3.waitRes: "I am sure that I am afraid, and sure that I want you anyway." She smiles, shaky. "Take a day. I will still be here, still afraid, still wanting."

jump.title: Tea and a Spell
jump.text: Kurenai has a gift for slipping past people's defenses; she's never used it for herself. Tonight, though, she appears at Sam's side in the corridor, silent as smoke, and says, "I almost cast something on you. A little nudge." Her eyes drop. "I stopped myself. I want you to say yes without help." Then: "Would you?"

image.comp: stepping out of shadow in a corridor, close to him, vulnerable crimson eyes, hands clasped
image.setting: dim upstairs corridor, a single wall lantern

jump.goRes: "Yes," Sam says, and she lets out a breath she's held for years before kissing him, gently, wholly herself.
jump.waitRes: "Never," Kurenai promises. "I should not have even considered it. Thank you for telling me plainly." She bows her head, lips curving. "That, too, was why I asked."

1.title: Dango Debt
1.text: Anko corners Sam in the kitchen with a stick of dango in each hand and her feet on the counter. "You bought me sweets for a whole month and never asked for anything," she says around a mouthful. "It's suspicious. Nobody's that nice for free." She leans in, snake-slit eyes glinting. "So I'm paying you back. Tasting first."

image.comp: perched on a kitchen counter with a dango stick in each hand, grinning, tilted head, slit-pupiled eyes glinting
image.setting: night kitchen, lanterns, a plate of sweets

1.goRes: She kisses him and tastes of honey and mischief. "Eh," she says after. "That was better than dango. Don't let it go to your head."
1.waitRes: "Hah! You're making me wait?" Anko grins and bites a dango off the stick. "I like you more now. Don't push it."

2.title: Hunger
2.text: Anko is a demon, and demons get hungry in more ways than one. She finds Sam at the stairs, eyes half-lidded, voice lower than usual. "I keep thinking about your hands," she says, which is an odd confession from someone who once frightened prisoners for a living. "Come here. Don't be shy. I'll only bite a little."

image.comp: leaning on the stair railing with half-lidded eyes, predatory playful grin, tongue just visible
image.setting: staircase, deep shadows, a lantern guttering

2.goRes: She does bite, a little, and then laughs, delighted by his gasp. The rest of the night is fast, warm, and loud.
2.waitRes: "Slower?" Anko pouts, then shrugs. "Fine. But I'm going to be insufferable about it." She grins and licks her thumb.

3.title: A Century of Takeout
3.text: Anko flops on Sam's bed uninvited, snacking, as if she lived there. "I spent a hundred years scaring people and ten years eating. Neither required a person." She goes quiet, which is unusual. "I'd like to see what it's like to need someone. You're a good candidate." Her grin wobbles into something sincere. "So? Staying in or kicking me out?"

image.comp: sprawled on a bed with a bag of sweets, grin turning sincere, snake-slit eyes warm
image.setting: his bedroom, rumpled blankets, a window with night sky

3.goRes: He climbs in beside her. The sweets are forgotten by midnight, which is a first.
3.waitRes: "No. That's the fun part." She grins and rolls over. "Take your time. I'll nap. Wake me when you've decided."

jump.title: Spontaneous
jump.text: Anko was mid-sentence about the price of dango when she stopped, stared at Sam, and said, "Huh. I think I want to kiss you." She tilts her head. "Weird. Usually I just eat things I want." She shrugs, takes his collar, and does exactly what she said. "There. Now I know. That's interesting."

image.comp: pulling him by the collar with a grin, caught mid-sentence, sweets in her other hand
image.setting: market street outside the house, paper lanterns, vendors in the background

jump.goRes: He kisses back, and she giggles, genuinely surprised at herself. "Huh. More, please."
jump.waitRes: "What? You looked kissable." She shrugs, unrepentant, and takes a bite of dango. "Okay, okay. Not in the street. Got it."

1.title: Strictly for the Pay
1.text: "I'm here strictly for the pay," Karin says for the fourth time this week, then adds, "Are you seeing anyone?" She adjusts her glasses, red-faced. "Don't answer. It's irrelevant. I can sense you, you know. Your life energy. It's very warm. And it gets warmer when you're near me. So." She grabs his sleeve. "May I?"

image.comp: pushing her glasses up with one hand, gripping his sleeve with the other, flustered defiant blush, long red hair
image.setting: bathhouse changing room, steam, wooden benches

1.goRes: She kisses him abruptly and a little too hard, then does it again, slower. "Stupid," she mutters. "I knew it'd be warm."
1.waitRes: Karin crosses her arms and glares at the floor. "Fine. I'll just... go be professional somewhere." She hesitates at the door. "I'm still asking about you being single. Just so you know."

2.title: Sensing Things
2.text: Sam is soaking after a long day when Karin enters to check the water, and stops dead. "Your energy's all jumpy," she says. "Nervous. It's... cute." She crouches by the edge, sleeves rolled, close enough to feel the steam. "I can tell you want to ask. Don't. Just let me." Her fingertips come to rest on his shoulder.

image.comp: kneeling at the edge of a bath with sleeves rolled, steamy flushed face, fingertips on his shoulder
image.setting: bathhouse, steam, hot spring pool, lantern light on wet wood

2.goRes: Her touch is certain, and then not certain, and then plainly the opposite of professional. The steam hides the rest.
2.waitRes: "Ugh, fine!" She flicks water at him, face scarlet. "You're lucky I'm patient. And lucky I like you."

3.title: Her Own Room
3.text: Karin finally stops pretending the pay is the reason. She knocks on Sam's door with a tray of tea, her glasses fogged. "I'm not stupid, I know how I act. I'm loud and sharp and I'm sorry." She wrings her hands. "I'd like you to stay with me. Tonight. Not for the money. Because I... I want somebody who stays."

image.comp: standing in a doorway with a tea tray, glasses fogged, hair messy, earnest hopeful face
image.setting: her small room, tea set, folded laundry

3.goRes: He takes the tray and she follows him in. The tea goes cold and she doesn't once act tough.
3.waitRes: "Y-yes. No. Ugh, yes." Karin glares at the floor. "But if you want to wait, I... I can wait. Just don't vanish."

jump.title: Jealous Streak
jump.text: A new client flirts with Karin and she snaps, "I'm taken," before she can stop herself. The client leaves. Sam stares. "Don't read into it!" she hisses, red to the roots, then swallows. "Fine. Read into it." She grabs his hand, drags him into the pantry and kisses him with fierce, awkward honesty.

image.comp: pulling him into a pantry by the hand, flustered and fierce, glasses askew, red hair wild
image.setting: pantry cupboard, shelves of jars, a single lantern

jump.goRes: Sam kisses her back, hands in her hair, and she makes a startled noise that she'll never admit to.
jump.waitRes: "A figure of speech!" Karin snaps, then shrinks. "...Mostly. Ugh. Let me think about it." She stays in the pantry, cheeks burning.

1.title: Marriage Prospects
1.text: "Don't speak," Mei says as Sam enters her office. "If it's about my age or my lack of a husband, you can leave." He doesn't. She studies him, one corner of her mouth lifting. "You didn't flinch. Most men do." She leans on her desk, poised as a queen. "I am going to kiss you. Do try to look honored."

image.comp: leaning on a desk with poised smirk, long auburn hair swept to one shoulder, confident gaze
image.setting: madame's office, polished desk, wine on a tray

1.goRes: He tries. She laughs, then kisses him, slow and sure, and he finds that looking honored requires no acting.
1.waitRes: Mei raises an elegant brow. "Later. How refreshingly cautious." She sips her wine, eyes bright. "I hope you realize I'll hold you to it."

2.title: Fortune and Folly
2.text: Mei pours two glasses of vintage and talks about the Mist, the cost of ruling, how long it's been since someone saw her instead of her title. "I'm done being feared," she says, setting her glass down. "I would like to be wanted. Does that make me foolish?" She slides closer along the sofa, perfume of salt air and plum. "Tell me honestly."

image.comp: reclining on a sofa with a wine glass, vulnerable bold smile, sliding closer, auburn hair loose
image.setting: private sitting room, plush sofa, wine decanter, candles

2.goRes: "Not foolish," Sam says, and she smiles with real warmth. What follows is gentle, unhurried, and thoroughly wanted.
2.waitRes: "I see." She smooths her skirt, composed. "I'm not offended. I did ask for honesty." A small, wry smile. "I'll try not to be too obvious in the meantime. No promises."

3.title: An Iron Reputation
3.text: Mei hangs up her robe of office and unpins her hair. "Everyone in the Mist knew my name," she says. "No one ever said it softly." She walks to Sam, her voice quiet. "Say my name, Sam. Softly. Then stay." It's the first time he has seen her uncertain, and it makes her more beautiful.

image.comp: standing in a silk robe with hair unpinned, expecting, gaze both bold and shy
image.setting: her opulent bedroom, silk drapes, evening light

3.goRes: "Mei," he says, and the iron reputation melts like candle wax. The night is long and the name is said often.
3.waitRes: "Certain?" Mei smiles, touched. "For the first time in years, yes. But I like that you asked." She squeezes his hand.

jump.title: Overdue
jump.text: Mei has been circling Sam for weeks, and tonight she corners him on the balcony with a bottle in hand. "I've waited a very long time for a husband," she says. "I'm tired of waiting for the word." She pulls him into a kiss she clearly rehearsed, then ruins it by laughing at herself. "Fine. I'm not as composed as I look. Kiss me back."

image.comp: pulling him into a kiss on a balcony, bottle in hand, laughing, slightly flushed
image.setting: balcony at night, city lights below, warm breeze

jump.goRes: He does, and her laughter turns breathless. "Oh, good," she whispers. "That was worth the wait."
jump.waitRes: "Slow?" She exhales, amused. "Very well. But you owe me a sunrise." She leans on the rail, eyes sparkling.

1.title: Paper Rose
1.text: Konan folds a white paper rose in silence, sets it in Sam's palm, then folds his fingers over it. "I was not made for words," she says, voice like rain on glass. "This is what I have. If you accept it, I would like to kiss you." Her eyes drop, solemn and shy. "I have never asked for anything in my life."

image.comp: holding out a paper rose in cupped hands, serene shy expression, short blue hair, a paper flower in her hair
image.setting: quiet corner of the dance room, paper cranes hanging from the ceiling

1.goRes: She kisses him with a stillness he did not expect, and when it ends he is certain the paper rose has learned how to bloom.
1.waitRes: Konan nods once, calm. "I understand. The rose is yours regardless." A faint, grateful smile. "Waiting is not unfamiliar to me."

2.title: Rain Hours
2.text: It rains all night. Konan sits at the window with her wings folded, watching droplets slide, until Sam brings her tea. "I was always the rain," she says. "Cold, quiet. People rarely wished to be near me." She takes his hand and presses it to her cheek. "You do. Stay a while."

image.comp: sitting at a rain-streaked window with folded wings, holding his hand against her cheek, serene soft smile
image.setting: window seat, rain on the glass, paper flowers on the sill

2.goRes: She lets him close, piece by piece, as careful as folding. The rain goes on, and the night with it.
2.waitRes: "Of course." Konan lets his hand go gently. "Rain is patient. It will return."

3.title: Unfolded
3.text: Konan has folded her whole life into squares, rebel, leader, angel, none of them quite hers. Tonight she sets aside the paper, and her wings, and asks quietly: "Would you help me unfold? It is difficult to do alone." Her voice is steady, her hands are not. "I do not know what is underneath. I would like you to be there when I find out."

image.comp: sitting on a bed with a sheet of paper in her lap, wings loosened, hopeful tentative expression
image.setting: her small room scattered with paper cranes, soft candlelight

3.goRes: He does. She is surprising, in every gentle way, and the paper cranes watch from the shelves.
3.waitRes: "I will be," Konan answers, honest. "But thank you for asking. I will tell you when the fold is ready."

jump.title: Sudden Gust
jump.text: A wind blows through the open hall window, scattering Konan's paper flowers across the floor. She bends to gather them. Sam bends too, and their hands touch, and neither moves. "I do not usually act," she says, "only observe." She leans in and kisses him, brief as petals. "I wanted to find out what it was like. It is... considerable."

image.comp: kneeling among scattered paper flowers, hand touching his, kissing him lightly, blushing quietly
image.setting: dance hall floor with scattered paper flowers, open window, curtains stirring

jump.goRes: He kisses her again, and the paper flowers settle around them like confetti.
jump.waitRes: "Of course." She retreats, composed, but her wings tremble. "I will observe a little longer." She gathers a flower and tucks it into his hand.

1.title: Audience with the Princess
1.text: Zelda requests a private audience, which is how she asks for everything. She waits in the garden pavilion, hood down, eyes steady. "I have studied your house for months," she says, "its books, its customs, its people. There is a variable I failed to account for." She smiles, faintly self-mocking. "You. I would like to kiss you, Sam. Formally, and then not formally."

image.comp: seated upright in a garden pavilion with hood lowered, hands in lap, composed with a warm smile, long elf ears
image.setting: garden pavilion at dusk, climbing roses, lantern light

1.goRes: The formal kiss is polite. The second is not. When she pulls away, a princess with flushed cheeks says, "Fascinating."
1.waitRes: "Of course." Zelda inclines her head, regal and unbothered. "Take whatever time you need. I have a good deal to read in the meantime."

2.title: Without the Crown
2.text: Sam finds Zelda on the roof, hood back, wind in her hair, the evening lanterns spread below. "At home I am always the princess," she says. "Everyone is gentle. Everyone bows." She meets his eyes. "You do not bow. It is a relief. Come sit. I wish to be touched by someone who sees me, not the crown."

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop with hood back, wind in her long hair, looking at him with open warm eyes
image.setting: rooftop at dusk, view over town lights

2.goRes: Her hand, then her lips, then a quiet laugh as she forgets to be regal. The stars take notice.
2.waitRes: "I understand." Zelda tilts her head. "I will keep the roof warm for another night."

3.title: A Kingdom of Two
3.text: Zelda sets down her book of sage lore and takes both Sam's hands. "I have governed, studied, and waited," she says. "I have made every decision of my life for others. This one is mine." She hesitates, a flicker of nerves under the poise. "Will you stay with me tonight? I would like to find out what it means to be only Zelda."

image.comp: standing in a simple nightgown with long hair down, holding his hands, gentle nervous smile
image.setting: her guest suite, tall window, moonlight, books on a table

3.goRes: He does. The princess learns that being only herself is a very pleasant thing, and a warm one.
3.waitRes: "I am." She smiles, soft. "But I admire the question. Ask again when you are comfortable; I am in no hurry."

jump.title: Royal Impulse
jump.text: Zelda is mid-lecture on the economics of a bar tab when she stops, flushes, and says, "I have lost my place." She looks at Sam, and the poise cracks. "I have been very composed for a hundred and twenty-eight years. It has become tiresome." She steps close and kisses him, and the book in her hand hits the floor.

image.comp: kissing him with a dropped book at her feet, startled at herself, poise cracking into a smile
image.setting: library nook, tall shelves, a fallen book

jump.goRes: He kisses back, and the princess forgets the economics entirely.
jump.waitRes: "Yes. Quite right." She picks up the book, blushing like a schoolgirl. "I will resume composure. Momentarily."

1.title: Imp No More
1.text: Midna floats onto the bar like it's a throne. "I was an imp for far too long," she says. "Small. Furious. Easy to ignore." Her smile is slow and wicked. "You never ignored me, even then. Come here, Sam." Her fingers hook his hoodie strings. "I am going to kiss you, and you are going to let me. Do try to look flattered."

image.comp: perched on the edge of a bar counter, long crimson hair, wicked amused smile, tugging his hoodie strings
image.setting: bar after hours, shimmering twilight light, empty stools

1.goRes: He tries and fails, and she laughs and kisses him anyway. "Adorable," she says. "Now, again."
1.waitRes: Midna arches an eyebrow. "You are making a queen wait? Bold." She smiles. "I like it. I will pretend to be offended for a day."

2.title: Show Me Off
2.text: Midna drags Sam onto the lounge floor, announcing to the room, "This one is mine for the evening." She winds an arm around his waist, delighted by the staring. "Let them watch. I enjoy it." Her hand slides to the small of his back and lingers. "And if you enjoy it too, you only need say so."

image.comp: leaning against him with an arm around his waist, delighted smirk, glancing at unseen onlookers
image.setting: lounge floor, twilight lanterns, curious regulars watching

2.goRes: "I enjoy it," Sam says, and the queen of twilight laughs, bright and warm, pulling him closer.
2.waitRes: "Spoilsport." She winks. "Fine. I will take you somewhere less crowded. But I will remember your hesitation."

3.title: Throne Room, Private
3.text: Midna's room is arranged like a palace chamber, cushions, shadow-curtain, a candle shaped like a crown. She lounges, one leg over the other. "I ruled a world," she says. "I do not often get to be chosen." The mask slips. "Choose me, Sam. Not for being a queen. For this." She gestures at herself, wicked and vulnerable all at once.

image.comp: reclining on cushions like a throne, one leg crossed, wicked smile fading into genuine vulnerability
image.setting: her private room, shadow curtain, a crown-shaped candle

3.goRes: He does. The queen lets her guard down, and the twilight outside seems a little brighter.
3.waitRes: "Of course I am," Midna says, then softer, "I like that you checked. Wait if you must. I will be here."

jump.title: Impulse Control
jump.text: Midna was in the middle of teasing Sam about a stain on his hoodie when she stopped, narrowed her eyes, and said, "Oh, bother." She grabs his collar. "I had a whole plan. A grand seduction. Instead, this." She kisses him quickly and smugly and then pulls back, flushed. "Don't you dare tell the other courtesans I improvised."

image.comp: grabbing his collar with a smug flushed grin, red hair tumbling, eyes bright
image.setting: upstairs hallway, a window showing twilight, lantern glow

jump.goRes: He kisses back and she melts, just a little. "Well," she says. "That went better than the plan."
jump.waitRes: "What? You are very kissable." She smirks, unrepentant, and releases him. "Fine. I'll plan it better. Be afraid."

1.title: Fresh Cream
1.text: Malon tops off a glass at the bar and slides it to Sam, humming one of her horse songs. "That's from my family's herd," she says. "Best in the kingdom, I swear." Then she bites her lip. "I came here to sell you milk. I stayed because of you. Do you know how silly that sounds? I keep trying to say it and it keeps coming out as dairy."

image.comp: leaning over a bar counter with a glass, cheeky bashful smile, red braid over one shoulder
image.setting: the house bar, wooden counter, glass jars of cream, afternoon light

1.goRes: She kisses him over the bar, tasting of cream and strawberries. "There," she says, laughing, "that came out clearer."
1.waitRes: "Sure! I'm not going anywhere." Malon grins and tops off his glass. "I've got the bar to run. And I'm very good at waiting."

2.title: Lullaby
2.text: Malon hums a lullaby while she wipes down the bar, a song that she says calms foals. Sam leans on the counter, drifting. "Works on people, too," she murmurs. She comes around the counter, takes his hand, and tilts her head. "Come here. I'd like to sing you the rest of the way to sleep. With some help from my hands."

image.comp: taking his hand with a sweet teasing smile, red braid swaying, humming softly
image.setting: bar after closing, lamplight, wiping cloth in hand

2.goRes: Her lullaby ends mid-verse, replaced by something warmer. The bar stays dark until dawn.
2.waitRes: "All right!" Malon pats his hand, cheerful. "We'll save it. A song's better for the wait."

3.title: Barn Dance
3.text: The ranch-style supper in the courtyard turns into a dance, Malon spinning Sam until he's dizzy. "I've waited ages for someone to dance with who isn't a horse," she laughs. As the music fades she keeps hold of his hands. "Stay with me tonight? I won't be shy about it. I'm done being shy."

image.comp: holding both his hands after a dance, hair coming loose, sweet bright flushed smile
image.setting: courtyard with strung lanterns, hay bales, dusk

3.goRes: She leads him up the stairs by the hand, still humming, and the lullaby finds a new verse.
3.waitRes: "Mm-hm." Malon smiles. "But I like that you check. Take a week if you need it; I've got plenty of songs."

jump.title: Sudden Song
jump.text: Malon is stacking mugs when she bursts into song, mid-sentence, then stops and covers her mouth. "Oh! Sorry! I do that when I'm happy." She looks at Sam. "And I'm happy. Very. When you're around." She hops up and kisses his cheek, then his mouth, giggling. "Okay. That was impulsive. I regret nothing!"

image.comp: hopping up to kiss him with a stack of mugs behind her, giggling, flushed, red braid bouncing
image.setting: bar back room, mugs and bottles, warm light

jump.goRes: He does, and she hums happily against his lips. "Mm. Now I'm going to be singing all week."
jump.waitRes: "I know!" Malon laughs, cheeks pink. "Sorry, sorry. Ranch girl. We act first." She picks up the mugs, humming.

1.title: Healing Fountain
1.text: Cotera drifts through the steam of the bathhouse, translucent, sparkling, giggling at nothing. "I have granted wishes for six hundred years," she says. "No one has ever wished for me." She settles in front of Sam, pink hair floating. "Make a wish, little one. A small one. I'll give you whatever you like." Her laugh rings off the tiles.

image.comp: floating just above the bath edge with sparkling mist around her, teasing smile, long hair drifting
image.setting: bathhouse, rising steam, glowing water, mist

1.goRes: Her kiss tastes of rain and cherry blossoms. "Granted," she says, giggling. "Now, another wish?"
1.waitRes: Cotera pouts, then laughs. "A patient wisher! Tsk. Fine, I'll wait. The fountain is always open."

2.title: Wishes Come True
2.text: Cotera has been unusually quiet for a spirit who normally can't stop talking. "I've been thinking about wishes," she says. She settles beside Sam on the stone edge, bare feet in the water. "I always grant. I never ask. Do you know how lonely that is?" Her laughter is quieter now. "I'd like to ask something of you, for once."

image.comp: sitting on the stone rim with bare feet in the water, soft vulnerable smile, shimmering skin
image.setting: bathhouse alcove, glowing water, soft fairy lights

2.goRes: She asks for his arms around her, and his lips on hers, and she takes it gladly. The water glows brighter.
2.waitRes: "Oh." Cotera blinks, then sparkles anyway. "Well. A fairy can wait. A few decades, even. Don't let it come to that."

3.title: Moonlit Fountain
3.text: Under the full moon, Cotera lets the bathhouse water shimmer with silver light. "The fountain loves to be visited," she says, drifting close, "and so do I." She takes Sam's hand and presses it flat to her chest, where something warm hums. "I am a creature of old magic, but I feel like a girl. Will you stay with me, little one?"

image.comp: floating close with his hand pressed to her chest, silver moonlight, soft smile
image.setting: bathhouse at night, moonlight on glowing water

3.goRes: He does. The water glows all night, and by morning the whole bathhouse is gossiping about the light.
3.waitRes: "Mm. Terribly sure," Cotera laughs. "But I admire you for asking. A fairy can wait. A little."

jump.title: Overflow
jump.text: Cotera is laughing at a gossipy client's story when she turns and notices Sam. "Oh!" she says, and the room's water ripples. "I've been trying to be subtle about this. I am a creature who sings in tile halls. Subtle isn't in me." She floats to him and kisses him, giggling. "There. That's what I've been trying to say for a month."

image.comp: kissing him mid-laughter, delighted, floating just above the tiles with sparkles drifting
image.setting: bathhouse, echoing tile hall, steam and sparkles

jump.goRes: He kisses back, and the bathwater overflows a little. She giggles about it for the rest of the night.
jump.waitRes: "Too sudden? Oh dear." She covers her mouth, laughing. "I'll rewind. Pretend that never happened. I'll do it again, subtler."

1.title: Spoils
1.text: Nabooru drops a small velvet pouch in Sam's lap. "Stole it from a bandit who deserved it," she says. Inside is a plain silver ring. "Not a proposal. A trophy." She leans against the doorway, arms folded, grinning with just a touch of nerves. "I figure I owe you a kiss for every honest thing you've done for this house. I'm going to start collecting."

image.comp: leaning in a doorway with arms folded, confident grin, braided red hair, a flicker of nerves
image.setting: the security post by the front door, a lantern, a stack of crates

1.goRes: She kisses him quickly, sure, and then slower. "One," she says, smiling. "Don't lose count."
1.waitRes: Nabooru raises her chin. "Later's fine. I've waited out sandstorms. I can wait out a nervous man." She nudges him, grinning.

2.title: Night Watch
2.text: They keep watch together on the roof, Nabooru's elbow bumping his, a quiet pleasant silence between jokes. "Most people turn nervous when I stand this close," she says. "You turn pink." Her hand finds the back of his neck. "I like the pink. I like you. Let's find out where this goes, thief to thief."

image.comp: sitting shoulder to shoulder on a rooftop, her hand at the back of his neck, confident warm smirk
image.setting: rooftop at night, stars, quiet city

2.goRes: The watch is forgotten. The roof is a good place to be wanted.
2.waitRes: "Fine." Nabooru's grin doesn't slip. "I'll keep my hands to myself. Probably." She elbows him, laughing.

3.title: Desert Heat
3.text: Nabooru's room is bare as a warrior's, a bedroll, a lamp, a spear mounted on the wall. She pours water for them both, then sits on the edge of the bed. "I've never needed anyone," she says plainly. "I'm changing my mind. Stay the night. I won't pretend it doesn't mean something."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a plain bed with arms resting on her knees, steady honest gaze
image.setting: her spare room, a spear on the wall, a single lamp, bedroll

3.goRes: She's fierce, then unexpectedly gentle. In the quiet after, she admits it's the best haul of her life.
3.waitRes: "I wouldn't have asked if I wasn't." Nabooru smirks. "But I'll give you a night. Think it over. I'm not going anywhere."

jump.title: Quick Hands
jump.text: Nabooru has lifted Sam's quill, notes, and wallet before he notices. "Just checking you're paying attention," she grins. Then she tucks the wallet back and, in the same motion, pulls him into a kiss. "And you didn't even feel that part coming. You're easy to steal from." Her grin turns soft. "But I'm keeping the heart. Tell no one."

image.comp: tucking a wallet back into his pocket while kissing him, grinning, quick-handed, red braid swinging
image.setting: security desk, scattered quills and papers, lantern light

jump.goRes: He kisses back. She keeps the quill, and he lets her.
jump.waitRes: "Fine, fine." She hands back the quill, smiling, no remorse. "But I'm not apologizing for the kiss."

1.title: Doctor's Orders
1.text: Sam is nursing a sprained wrist when Mio sweeps into the kitchen, coat swinging, and takes his arm without asking. Her fingers are cool and exact. "Star's rule: the patient holds still." She wraps the bandage, then keeps hold of his hand. "Now. You've been looking at my mouth all week, Sam. I wore the lipstick on purpose." Outside the window the lanterns gutter, and Mio does not so much as glance at the coat she left on the chair.

image.comp: holding his wrist in both hands, dark wine lips curved in a knowing smirk, one eyebrow raised
image.setting: kitchen late in the evening, bandages and a lamp on the table

1.goRes: Her laugh turns into a hum against his mouth. Mio kisses like she walks into a room, and for once Sam is the one everyone is looking at.
1.waitRes: "Of course you are." Mio pats the bandage twice, perfectly unbothered. "The invitation doesn't expire, darling. I just like making a man wait for it."

2.title: Medic's Hands
2.text: The lounge is empty after the last client. Mio sits Sam on the arm of a couch, coat slipping off one shoulder. "You carry everything in your back, you know. I could always tell, even in the field." Her thumbs press into his shoulders, then drift lower, slow, in no hurry at all. "Tell me when it stops being treatment." The lanterns are low, the couches are deep, and she makes it very clear she has no intention of being quick about it.

image.comp: standing behind him with her coat slipping off one shoulder, hands on his shoulders, bold sidelong glance
image.setting: empty lounge after closing, a few lanterns left burning

2.goRes: "Oh, good," Mio breathes, and the treatment becomes something else entirely, her hands as sure as they ever were on a battlefield.
2.wait: "Keep going. I'm not ready to stop it."
2.waitRes: Mio's hands pause, then resume the plain massage with a theatrical sigh. "Patient's choice. But I'm marking you down as a tease."

3.title: Open Door
3.text: Mio's room has a glass of wine poured for him already, and her coat is hung neatly on its hook, the first time Sam has seen it off her. "I trained a hundred healers to be calm before the worst night of anyone's life," she says. "I've never once been calm about this." The choker catches the candlelight. "Stay." There is no performance in the room, only a woman who has spent a century making sure everyone looks, now asking one person to stay.

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed in a silk robe, choker catching candlelight, a rare uncertain smile
image.setting: her bedroom, candles and a wine bottle on the nightstand

3.goRes: She doesn't need an audience this time. Mio pulls him down beside her, and the candle burns low on the first quiet night of her life that is entirely hers.
3.wait: "Are you sure it's me you want?"
3.waitRes: "Ask me again in a week," Mio says, smiling, though her thumb lingers on his sleeve. "I'll give you the same answer. Louder, probably."

jump.title: Too Long Staring
