jump.text: Sam has caught Mio lingering outside his door twice this week, and she's finished pretending. She walks him backward into the linen closet, coat swinging shut behind them. "A hundred and eighteen years, Sam. I know exactly what I want and exactly how long I'm willing to wait. Which, it turns out, is until about now." The shelves smell of lavender and starch, and she is smiling the way she does just before she takes the stage.

image.comp: pressing him against a shelf with a hand on his chest, wine-dark lips and a predatory grin
image.setting: narrow linen closet, lantern light slanting through the door crack

jump.goRes: He's more than willing. Mio's laugh is low and delighted, and the coat stays on exactly long enough to hide the door closing.
jump.waitRes: "Fair." She smooths his hoodie, unashamed. "I'd prefer a bed with an audience anyway. Name the night."

1.title: Someone to Notice
1.text: Emi has been the last one up for weeks, checking the locks twice. Tonight Sam finds her at the back door, ponytail loose, a mug of tea cooling in her hands. "Nobody ever asks who checks on me," she says, a little embarrassed. "You did. Every night." She puts the mug down. "I'd like to thank you properly, if that's all right." The house is finally quiet, and the lantern throws her calm face into soft gold. Emi has never once asked for anything for herself.

image.comp: standing at a back door with a tea mug set down beside her, shy composed smile, ponytail slightly loose
image.setting: back door of the house at night, a single lantern

1.goRes: It's a soft, careful kiss, the kind she'd give someone she's decided to keep safe. Emi's shoulders drop for the first time all day.
1.waitRes: Emi huffs a small laugh and picks the mug up again. "You sound like me. All right. I'll still be on door duty tomorrow, Sam."

2.title: Off Duty
2.text: Emi wears the soft blue wrap dress for once, sitting beside Sam on the porch step with her scarf folded in her lap. "Everyone's asleep and every lock is turned. For tonight, I'm not guarding anything." She leans her head on his shoulder, then turns it. "I've never been shy about fighting. This is much harder." A cricket starts up in the garden. Her scarf is in her lap, and she is holding it the way other people hold a hand.

image.comp: sitting close on a porch step in a soft wrap dress, head tilted up toward him, blushing and sincere
image.setting: house porch at night, moths around the lantern, quiet street

2.goRes: Her breath hitches, then eases. Emi's hands, always so steady, tremble just a little as she finally lets herself be taken care of.
2.wait: "We have all the time we need."
2.waitRes: "I know," Emi says, and she's smiling, relieved and a little disappointed in equal measure. "I'll keep the porch warm."

3.title: The Last Lock
3.text: Emi finishes the rounds and, instead of her own room, stops at Sam's door. She still holds the ring of keys, and she sets them down on his desk with a quiet clink. "All done," she says. "Everyone's safe. I'd like to stop being the strong one for a night." Her voice is steady. Her fingers, on the doorframe, are not. Down the hall every door is bolted and every window latched, and she has done it all herself, as she always does, before coming to him.

image.comp: standing in a doorway holding a ring of keys against her chest, warm trusting smile, ponytail down over one shoulder
image.setting: Sam's bedroom doorway, lamplight inside, hallway dark

3.goRes: He takes the keys and sets them aside. She is the one the house leans on, so he is gentle, and Emi cries a little, and smiles through it.
3.wait: "Are you sure you're not just tired?"
3.waitRes: "Mm. Tired, and sure." Emi tucks the keys back in her belt. "But I'll respect it. Ask me again when I'm only one of those."

jump.title: Stopped Cold
jump.text: A drunk client gets handsy with Sam's friend in the hall, and Emi settles it without raising her voice: he simply cannot move. Afterward she leans against the wall, shaking out her hands. "I was so frightened it would be you," she says, quietly furious at herself. "I can't pretend about this anymore." She kisses him, quick and fierce. For years she has been the one who stops other people's trouble before it reaches anyone. This time it nearly reached him.

image.comp: leaning against a hallway wall with her hands up, wide-eyed, caught mid-confession and flushed
image.setting: upstairs hallway, a toppled chair in the background

jump.goRes: Her whole composure folds. He holds her until the shaking stops, and then she kisses him again slowly, as if she'd rather not stop at all.
jump.waitRes: "Not yet." Emi straightens her scarf, eyes bright. "I'm allowed. But you're the one making it so easy. Give me a moment."

1.title: Encore
1.text: The stage lights are down and the crowd is gone when Hibiki drops from the rafters in a swirl of wings and lands on Sam's lap, guitar still humming. "Best crowd tonight? You. Front row, every show." She taps his nose. "I've been playing every song at you. Did you get the message, or do I need a bridge?" The green glow on the strings fades slowly, and without the crowd the hall is large and soft. Her wings brush the curtain as she settles.

image.comp: perched on the edge of a stage with a glowing-stringed guitar across her knees, bat wings half unfurled, teasing grin
image.setting: empty stage after a show, green light fading on the strings

1.goRes: She tastes like honey tea and smoke. Hibiki's wings flutter behind her, and the last string rings out on its own.
1.waitRes: "A bridge! He wants a bridge." Hibiki cackles and strums one wild chord. "Fine, darling. I'll write you a whole album."

2.title: Dressing Room Mirror
2.text: Backstage, Hibiki sits at the mirror, powder smeared on her cheek, and doesn't turn when Sam knocks. "Zip me out of this? The back clasp always sticks." Her eyes meet his in the glass, red-violet and gleaming. "I'm fond of an audience, but this one I'd like to keep to one." Rouge pots and feathered hairpins crowd the table. A single bulb buzzes. It is the one place she never plays to anyone.

image.comp: sitting at a dressing-room mirror with her back to him, looking over a bare shoulder with a playful dare
image.setting: backstage dressing room, bulbs round the mirror, costume rack

2.goRes: The clasp gives easily. It is not at all what the song promised, only close and breathless, and Hibiki, for once, stops talking.
2.waitRes: "Rude! The clasp never waits." She grins into the mirror all the same. "Come back when you've worked up your nerve. I'll keep the lights on."

3.title: Quiet Set
3.text: Nobody expects Hibiki to turn the amp off. She plays in Sam's room, unplugged, a slow song he's never heard, wings folded close. "This one doesn't go on the setlist." She puts the guitar on its stand and looks, for the first time since he met her, a little afraid. "Stay with me? Until morning?" There are no lights, no amps and no encore. She is quieter than he has ever heard her, which in itself is a kind of music.

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed with her guitar laid aside, wings folded, soft vulnerable smile
image.setting: Sam's bedroom, one lamp low, guitar stand in the corner

3.goRes: The song ends in the dark, and the rest of the night is not performance, just warmth, wings wrapped around him like a curtain.
3.wait: "Are you sure? It's a big song."
3.waitRes: "I wrote it for you, Sam, of course I'm sure." She laughs, wobbly. "Take your time. It's a long tour."

jump.title: Stage Dive
jump.text: Hibiki flies right off the stage at the end of the final number, through a gasping crowd, straight into Sam's arms at the bar. The room erupts. She laughs in his ear, breathless. "Tell me you didn't feel that," she whispers, wings still half out. "Because I have wanted to do that since the day I got here." Chairs scrape, glasses clink, and someone whoops in the dark. Hibiki's grin is wicked and entirely sincere.

image.comp: caught mid-air in his arms, wings spread behind her, flushed and laughing, guitar slung on her back
image.setting: crowded lounge, spotlights, cheering guests blurred behind

jump.goRes: Her mouth finds his in front of everyone. Hibiki, for once, has no banter ready.
jump.waitRes: "Spoilsport." Hibiki hops down, dazzling smile intact. "Don't think I'll forget. I'm the type to do an encore."

1.title: Soot Smudge
1.text: The third flambe of the night goes wrong, and Choko is on Sam's side of the bar in a heartbeat, patting out his sleeve. "Out! It's out!" Her laugh cuts off when they're nose to nose. "I don't really do kissing," she mutters, red under the soot. "It's too soft. But I keep looking at your mouth, which is annoying." The bar still smells of scorched sugar and rum, and she keeps wiping the same patch of counter, ears pink under her flyaways.

image.comp: leaning over a bar counter toward him with a soot smudge on her cheek, amber eyes wide, grinning in fluster
image.setting: bar, scorched counter, bottles and a bucket of water

1.go: Wipe the smudge and kiss her
1.goRes: She goes rigid, then melts all at once. "Huh," Choko says, dazed. "That was not bad." She grabs his collar and does it again, hard.
1.waitRes: "Ha! Coward." Choko slaps the counter. "Fine, I'll get the bucket. But I won him over once. I'll do it again."

2.title: Barrel Room
2.text: Choko drags Sam down to the cellar to help with a barrel, though the barrel is clearly fine. She leans on it, forearm seals glowing faintly in the dim. "I make the best drinks in town and nobody's made me one." Her smile is cocky, nerves showing. "So. Your turn. Show me you can handle heat." The cellar is cool and smells of oak and cedar. She pours two mugs of something dark, spills a bit, and swears cheerfully.

image.comp: leaning against a barrel with arms crossed, ink seals glowing faintly on her forearms, challenging smirk
image.setting: cellar of the bar, barrels and lantern light

2.goRes: She is all competition and warmth, a dwarf's grip, a flaring laugh, and when she finally goes quiet it is in a very good way.
2.waitRes: "Pfft. You are no fun." She pours two cups anyway and clinks hers against his. "Next time I'm winning the contest, not the barrel."

3.title: Cooldown
3.text: Closing time. Choko has banked the bar, no fire this time, and presses a glass of something amber into Sam's hands. "Special blend. Slow burn." She is oddly quiet, picking at the soot under her nails. "I don't know how to be soft. Be patient with me? Come upstairs." The room above the bar is small, with a patched quilt and a window that smells of woodsmoke. She has never invited anyone here before.

image.comp: standing in a quiet doorway wiping her hands on a towel, soft rare smile, ponytail messy
image.setting: small upstairs room above the bar, warm lamplight

3.goRes: It starts out as a contest and ends as anything but. Choko falls asleep on his chest with the stubborn grip of a girl who wins.
3.waitRes: "I'm sure, idiot." She punches his shoulder, grinning. "But I'm not racing you. Come find me when you're ready."

jump.title: Dare
jump.text: The staff's drinking game gets loud, and somebody dares Choko to kiss the owner. She snorts and slams her mug down. "Not for the dare," she says, standing, fists on her hips. "I'm doing it because I want to and these idiots need to shut up about it." She marches around the table. The crowd howls. She looks across the table at Sam, soot on her chin, and the bet suddenly means a great deal more than a bet.

image.comp: standing with fists on her hips, flushed and fierce, a mug raised in one hand
image.setting: busy bar common room, lanterns and cheering silhouettes

jump.goRes: The room cheers and she waves them off, red to the ears. "Told you," she says into his shoulder. "Heat of the moment. I'm taking you upstairs before it fades."
jump.waitRes: "Ha!" Choko drains her mug, undaunted. "Another time, then. Warm the bed up, Sam."

1.title: Beetle Report
1.text: Saya finishes her morning report, then stays. "The beetles keep reporting a heart rate I can't explain," she says, reading from nothing. Her visor is pushed into her hair. "It happens whenever you're near. I pulled the colony off you, so now I only have my own data." She closes the gap. "I'd like a second sample." Dust turns in the slanting sun between the shelves. She has set her report down, which, for Saya, is a declaration of intent.

image.comp: standing with her visor pushed up into long dark hair, composed face cracking into a small blush
image.setting: quiet corner of the library, afternoon light on shelves

1.goRes: She kisses like she researches: thoroughly. When she pulls back, Saya whispers, "Fascinating," and drags him in again.
1.waitRes: "There is no one to review it," Saya says dryly, though her ears are pink. "I'll redo the experiment later. Control group of one."

2.title: Off the Record
2.text: Saya's room smells of ink and old paper, beetles drifting over the lamp. She has dismissed every one of them, and shows him the empty air. "Nothing is listening tonight. No one will know." She takes his hand and presses it, shyly, to her own pounding pulse. "I've learned everything about this house. Except this." Pressed flowers are tucked between her papers like bookmarks. Outside, the night is calm, and so, with great effort, is her voice.

image.comp: sitting at a desk covered in notes, visor off, holding his hand to her chest, earnest blush
image.setting: her room, lamplit desk, stacks of notes and paper

2.goRes: Saya, who knows everything, learns it with her eyes closed. She is curious, then breathless, then not curious at all.
2.wait: "I want to be sure you're comfortable."
2.waitRes: "I appreciate it." Saya nods, solemn, and writes something on her palm. "I'm adding it to my list. Please do not read the list."

3.title: Contingency
3.text: Saya has a plan for tonight. She says so, standing at Sam's door with a folded sheet. "Item one: arrive. Item two: tell you I'm frightened." She holds the paper out, hands shaking. "Item three I never wrote. I wanted it to be a surprise to me too." The visor is nowhere in sight. She has memorized the whole house but never this particular hallway, and her step down it is slow, deliberate and a little shy.

image.comp: standing at a bedroom door holding a folded paper, unmasked, hopeful and nervous
image.setting: Sam's bedroom door, soft candlelight from inside

3.go: Step aside and let her in
3.goRes: She comes in as though entering the first room of her life. Item three turns out to be wonderful, and no one will ever read the paper.
3.waitRes: "Of course." Saya folds the sheet and puts it in her sleeve. "Plans can be revised. I'll rewrite it."

jump.title: Unscheduled
jump.text: Saya knocks over the whole shelf looking for a scroll, and Sam catches her before the last book falls. She stares up at him, breathless. "This was not in the forecast." Her voice is smaller than he's ever heard it. "I have no contingency for this. I'd like to improvise." Dust floats down, a candle gutters, and for a breath neither of them says anything at all. Then she says, very quietly, his name.

image.comp: caught in his arms amid a few toppled books, visor slipped to her forehead, startled and bright-eyed
image.setting: library, books scattered, dust in sunbeams

jump.goRes: Improvised, and perfect. Saya, who has never been unprepared, turns out to be gifted at it.
jump.waitRes: "Sensible," Saya says, flushed and already shelving books. "We can improvise tomorrow. I will note the time."

1.title: Overheated
1.text: Juju has been in the bathhouse boiler room since dawn, arms black to the elbow, and she shoves a wrench at Sam. "Hold that. No, that. Good." She wipes her face, smearing soot. "You're good at this. Standing still and being patient, I mean. It makes me want to try something." Her twin tails bounce as she leans in. The pipes tick and groan around them, and a haze of steam clings to her twin tails like a halo. She is grinning, of course.

image.comp: leaning toward him with a wrench in one hand and a smear of grease on her cheek, bright mischievous smile
image.setting: bathhouse boiler room, pipes and steam

1.goRes: She tastes like steam and tea. Juju drops the wrench and clutches his hoodie, and the pipes behind them hiss as if applauding.
1.waitRes: "Boring!" Juju grins and picks the wrench back up. "But I'll tune it fast. And then I'm collecting."

2.title: Gadget Test
2.text: Juju has built something, and it's clearly not for the bath. "A massage chair. Prototype. It's got gears." She pushes Sam into it, and it hums, and her hands go tentative on his shoulders. "The chair does the shoulders. I do the rest. If you let me." Her grin is a shade too bright. Gears, springs and half-finished contraptions cover every surface, and she has cleared exactly one corner for the two of them.

image.comp: standing over him in a workshop with her forearm interfaces glowing softly, flustered but daring
image.setting: workshop corner behind the baths, tools and a humming gadget

2.goRes: The chair stops working about a minute in. Juju swears, laughs, and has to take over by hand, and decides she prefers that.
2.waitRes: "Okay, okay." Juju flips a switch with a huff. "Version two will have a better pitch. Come back to me."

3.title: Steam Vents
3.text: Juju turns off the boilers herself, the whole bathhouse hushed, tools hung neatly for once. "Guess I'm a lot," she says, not looking at him. "Everyone says it. You never do. I'd like to be a lot for one person, just tonight." She's still in her cheongsam, buttons gleaming. "Stay. I'll fix the roof leak tomorrow." Without the clank of tools the bathhouse is oddly peaceful, and the water ripples when she shifts, small and nervous and wonderfully honest.

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a tub with her feet in warm water, hair buns loosened, quiet vulnerable smile
image.setting: bathhouse after hours, warm steam, lamps low

3.goRes: She is a lot. She is also tender, and loud, then quiet, and for once there is no gadget in the room but the two of them.
3.wait: "Are you sure? You don't have to prove anything."
3.waitRes: "I'm not proving anything," Juju says, small. "I'm choosing. But okay. Rain check."

jump.title: Short Circuit
jump.text: A pipe bursts and Juju slams Sam against the wall to shield him from the spray. Steam everywhere, her hair half out of its buns. She's laughing, soaked, hands on his chest. "You didn't even flinch!" The laughter fades. "Okay. New plan. I'm kissing you, and then I'm fixing the pipe. In that order." Water drums on the tile, the lamps flicker, and every wise thing she ever planned to say goes straight out of her head.

image.comp: soaked and laughing, hands on his chest, hair buns coming loose, eyes bright with sudden intent
image.setting: bathhouse hallway, spraying pipe, steam

jump.goRes: She kisses him with her whole body, then, after a long minute, remembers the pipe. "Hold that thought," she pants, "and the wrench."
jump.waitRes: "The pipe, yes." She wipes her face, beaming. "But I'm coming back for you."

1.title: Six Hours
1.text: Nami has been perfecting one breeze for most of the afternoon, and it finally ruffles Sam's hair, soft as breath. "There. That took six hours," she says, lying on the veranda with her hair spilling off the edge. "It's for you. I forgot lunch. I also forgot to mention that I think I'd like to kiss you." The curtains drift in and out like slow breath. She lets the breeze ease her hair across his shoulder before she says another word.

image.comp: lying lazily on a veranda with copper hair spilling off the edge, folding fans on her chest, sleepy smile
image.setting: sunlit veranda, a breeze moving the curtains

1.goRes: Unhurried, drowsy, completely there. The curtains billow as if they've been waiting for it too.
1.waitRes: "Mm. Not yet." Nami waves a fan, unbothered. "Feed me. I'll kiss you after. Perhaps."

2.title: Slow Hands
2.text: Nami has decided Sam is too tense, and arranges him on cushions with the tools of a woman who has all the time in the world. Her fans are folded away. "Massage is my favorite thing to receive," she admits. "But I'll give one first. You don't mind going further? Nothing's hurried. That's the point." Amber light slants in and the cushions are soft. She has forgotten, happily, that there is anywhere else in the world to be.

image.comp: kneeling beside him on cushions with a gentle smirk, sleeves slipping, long copper hair trailing
image.setting: lounge floor with cushions and slanting amber light

2.goRes: Nami never rushes, and Sam learns what it is to be taken slowly, as if a breeze had hands.
2.waitRes: "Perfect." She seems entirely content, and falls asleep halfway through. "Best offer I've had all week."

3.title: Where the Wind Settles
3.text: Nami is not in bed when Sam arrives. She's on the roof, wrapped in her gold silk, copper hair flowing away from her. "I drifted for a hundred years," she says. "Never settled. Don't tell the wind." She holds out one hand. "Come lie down with me. I think I'd like to stay somewhere." The shingles are still warm from the day, and every breeze holds its breath. Even the wind, it seems, wants her to stay put.

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop at dusk, gold silk wrapping her shoulders, hand held out to him, calm affectionate smile
image.setting: rooftop at dusk, a faint wind and the first stars

3.goRes: They never quite make it back inside. The wind is warm, her hair is everywhere, and the night is slow, quiet and entirely theirs.
3.wait: "Are you sure you want to settle?"
3.waitRes: "Sure enough to try." Nami pats the roof beside her. "Stay anyway, and we'll count stars. The rest can wait."

jump.title: Forgot to Be Shy
jump.text: Nami wanders into Sam's room in the afternoon to nap, because it's the sunniest, and has gotten halfway through undoing her sash before she notices him. "Oh. Hello." She blinks, thinks about it for a full breath, and lets the sash fall. "I was about to be lazy. I think I'd rather be something else." Dust motes spin in the light. Her smile is slow and sleepy, and has not a single doubt in it.

image.comp: standing sleepily in a sunlit room with her sash half undone, copper hair loose, unabashed languid smile
image.setting: Sam's sunlit bedroom, curtains stirring

jump.goRes: She falls into him like she falls into everything, easy and warm, and the afternoon vanishes without a single clock.
jump.waitRes: "Good plan." She curls up on his bed, eyes closing. "Wake me when you're certain."

1.title: Unlisted Variable
1.text: Maki has a notebook open on the counter, titled in neat letters: Prospects. Sam's name is crossed out, then written again, then crossed out. She notices him reading it upside down. "I optimized everything," she says calmly, closing it. "And then I stopped caring about the spreadsheet and started caring about you. It's inefficient. Kiss me anyway." The desk is tidy, the lamp is lit, and she is quite visibly out of her depth, which is the most charming thing he has ever seen.

image.comp: holding a closed notebook against her chest, grey-blue eyes direct, composed with a faint blush
image.setting: tidy office, evening light on a polished desk

1.goRes: Elegant, as expected, until it isn't. Maki's notebook slides off the counter and neither of them reaches for it.
1.wait: "Let me read the next page first."
1.waitRes: "There is no next page." Maki's smile is rueful. "Which is the problem. Ask me again when I've drafted a plan for this."

2.title: Presentation
2.text: Maki lays out three evening dresses on her bed and asks Sam's opinion, as if it were a client meeting. He says the navy. She nods, then sets the dress aside, unzipping instead the one she's wearing. "I've spent a year presenting myself. Tonight I'd like to be seen, and not graded." The mirror reflects the two of them and the stack of discarded gowns. She has never been looked at without knowing exactly what she wanted back.

image.comp: standing before a mirror with one strap slipped, looking back at him with a quiet steady gaze
image.setting: her bedroom, three dresses laid on the bed, lamp glow

2.goRes: He looks, and she lets him. For once nothing is a performance, and her careful composure comes undone with a laugh.
2.wait: "You don't need to present for me."
2.waitRes: "I know," Maki says softly, retying the strap. "That's why I want to. Soon, though. Not tonight."

3.title: Without Notes
3.text: Maki arrives at Sam's door with no notebook, no jewelry, hair loose. "I tried to prepare," she says. "I read everything. It didn't help." Her hand, so careful with every glass and fork, shakes slightly on the doorframe. "The truth is I'm in love with you, and I have no strategy. Would you let me stay?" The house sleeps below. She has laid out nothing, folded nothing, planned nothing, and she looks lighter for it than he has ever seen her.

image.comp: standing at a door in a plain robe with her hair loose and no jewelry, earnest and a little frightened
image.setting: Sam's bedroom doorway, warm lamplight

3.goRes: She stays. The most polished woman in the house comes undone slowly and gladly, and falls asleep with her face against his neck.
3.waitRes: "There's nothing to rush for," Maki says with a small smile, and doesn't leave. "But yes, ask me again."

jump.title: Off Script
jump.text: A client spills wine down Maki's dress and she handles it perfectly, until she retreats to the pantry and Sam finds her trembling with laughter. "I had a plan. For the evening. For my whole year." She grabs his lapels. "This is the least efficient thing I've ever wanted. Come here." Barrels clink, someone laughs in the hall, and the person she has been polishing herself into for a year simply gives up on being polished.

image.comp: laughing in a pantry doorway with wine stains on her navy dress, hand fisted in his hoodie
image.setting: pantry shelves, lantern light, jars behind her

jump.goRes: The least efficient decision of her life. She does not appear to regret a single second of it.
jump.wait: "Maybe change out of the wine first?"
jump.waitRes: "Sensible," Maki sighs, dabbing at her dress. "You are annoyingly practical. It is one of your qualities."

1.title: Wire-Thin
1.text: Saki's right hand wobbles as she threads a marionette, the wooden joints clicking, and she mutters a word that would make the lounge blush. "It's not the arm." Sam is close enough to see the paint on her cheek. "It's you being nearby. I keep losing the thread." She sets the puppet down. "Can I try something? I'm told I'm good with my hands." Painted faces and wooden hands dangle above them like an audience. She has stopped threading the puppet and begun, quietly, to hope.

image.comp: sitting cross-legged with a marionette in her lap, purple face paint, glancing up shyly, puppet-craft arm raised
image.setting: backstage workshop, marionettes hanging from the rafters

1.goRes: Her kiss is careful, as if testing a wire, then surer. The puppet in her lap slumps over, forgotten.
1.waitRes: "Practice." Saki gives a short laugh. "I can do practice. Don't go anywhere."

2.title: Strings Attached
2.text: After the late show, Saki cuts the cords on her stage coat and sits on the dressing room floor, mechanical hand in her lap. "It doesn't feel what the rest of me feels," she says, flat on purpose. "I'm still learning which parts do." She holds the metal fingers out to him. "Would you help me find out?" The stage costumes glitter on their pegs. The wire at her wrist hums faintly, and the hand it moves trembles more than the rest of her.

image.comp: seated on a dressing-room floor offering her mechanical hand, bold face paint smudged, hopeful guarded eyes
image.setting: backstage dressing room, stage coat draped over a chair

2.goRes: The metal is warm from the lamps. Saki breathes in sharply at his touch, then smiles, wide and astonished, as the feeling comes home.
2.waitRes: "I do. That's the strange part." Saki curls her fingers around his. "But I'd like to be sure. Soon."

3.title: Alive
3.text: Saki's room has a blanket fort, which she refuses to explain. She lights a candle inside and pats the floor beside her. "I was built. Then I woke up. Nobody told me what to do next." The paint is off her face for once, freckles and all. "I'd like to pick this part myself. I pick you." The candle makes the fort glow like a lantern. She has made herself small in it, and wants him to see exactly how brave that is.

image.comp: sitting inside a cozy blanket fort with her paint wiped off, soft smile, mechanical hand resting over his
image.setting: her room, a blanket fort lit by one candle

3.goRes: It is the most deliberate, chosen night of her life, and she says so afterward, laughing and a little amazed.
3.wait: "Are you sure? I'm happy to wait."
3.waitRes: "You can wait," Saki says, and means it. "I've got years. But I'm picking you eventually. Fair warning."

jump.title: Cut the Strings
jump.text: Saki's puppet show ends in a kiss on stage, scripted, and the audience cheers. Backstage she drops the puppet and keeps going, pulling Sam down by the front of his hoodie. "The script ended thirty seconds ago," she says, breathless. "I'm improvising. Do you mind?" The crowd is still applauding on the far side of the canvas. Her face paint is smeared, her eyes are huge, and she looks gloriously alive.

image.comp: pulling him by his hoodie behind a stage curtain, face paint smudged, mischievous breathless grin
image.setting: behind the stage curtain, rope rigging and soft glow

jump.goRes: He doesn't mind. She's an improviser by nature, and all the strings she's ever worn have been cut.
jump.waitRes: "Right. Props backstage, no witnesses." Saki winks. "Tonight, then. I'll write the script."

1.title: Unhooded
1.text: Sam notices a smudge of flour on the folds of Yori's hood, and brushes it off before he thinks. She goes absolutely still. "No one sees me," she says, in the voice of someone deciding something. "It's a skill. But you do." The mask comes down, only slightly, one finger holding it. "Please don't look away." A single window lets in the last grey light. She has not once been seen here, and now she stands in plain view, shaking slightly.

image.comp: standing in a dim linen room with her hood up, mask lowered by one finger, grey eyes wide and trembling
image.setting: linen room at dusk, folded sheets and a single window

1.goRes: The kiss is brief and shaking. When she pulls the mask back up, her eyes are smiling over it, and she is lighter than he has ever seen.
1.waitRes: Yori nods, mask back in place, and slips away almost unseen. At the door she pauses. "Thank you. For noticing. Even now."

2.title: Not Forgotten
2.text: Yori finds Sam in the upstairs hall late at night and fusses with a picture frame that does not need straightening. "I was thinking," she says to the wall. "Everyone forgets me. You don't. It's frightening." She turns, hood still up. "Could I be forgotten somewhere else, tonight? Somewhere with you?" The hall clock ticks. She has spent a hundred years working to be overlooked, and the effort of asking to be seen shows in every line of her.

image.comp: standing in a quiet hallway with her hood up and a hand trembling at the frame, shy sidelong look
image.setting: upstairs hallway at night, one lamp, long shadows

2.goRes: In the dark of his room, her cloak slides off her shoulders at last. It is an act of trust, and he treats it like one, gently.
2.waitRes: "Oh." Yori's relief is audible. "Yes. Talking would be good." She sits down, still wrapped in the cloak, and tells him a story.

3.title: Hair Down
3.text: Yori shuts the door and, with a steady breath, drops her hood. Hair the blue-purple of twilight spills to the floor. She takes off the mask, then the cloak, hanging each one on a peg. "No one has seen me without them. Not in years." She tries a nervous smile. "Is it all right?" She is breathtaking, and she has no idea. The lamp is turned low and the door is shut. Every layer she has worn to hide has been hung away, and she is waiting with her heart in her hands.

image.comp: standing barefoot in a bedroom with very long blue-purple hair finally loose, her mask in her hand, tentative wondering smile
image.setting: a small bedroom lit by a single lamp, cloak on a peg

3.goRes: He tells her, and she doesn't believe it, then she does. It is the quietest, most careful night, and she doesn't vanish from it.
3.wait: "You don't have to do this tonight."
3.waitRes: "I know," Yori says, and doesn't put the cloak back on. "But I wanted you to see. That's enough for now."

jump.title: Quiet Thunder
jump.text: A client barges into the laundry and doesn't see Yori in the corner, until Sam does. She watches him quietly send the man away, and something shifts in her face. After, she steps from the shadows and tugs the hem of his hoodie. "You saw me," she whispers. "Every time. I can't pretend that doesn't matter." Rain patters on the high window. She is not hiding now, and her grey eyes are fierce with a feeling she has no practice naming.

image.comp: stepping out of the shadows in a hooded cloak, one hand tugging his hoodie, intense hushed gaze
image.setting: laundry room, steam and hanging linens

jump.goRes: He does. For once, Yori holds the contact, and the mask comes down, and the moment fills the room like rain on a roof.
jump.waitRes: "Yes." She breathes. "I just need a moment to decide how brave I am. Tomorrow, perhaps."

1.title: One Kind Gesture
1.text: Sam hands Nozomi a warm cup of tea after a rough shift, nothing more. She stares at it like it might bite. "I know what this is," she says unsteadily. "One kind thing, and I'm gone. I've done it before." She sets the cup down. "I've been trying to keep away. But I'm tired of keeping away from you." The teapot ticks as it cools, and the last light turns the tiles gold. She has run out of ways to look away.

image.comp: holding a steaming cup in both hands and looking up with a blush, soft brown-hazel eyes shining
image.setting: kitchen at twilight, a window with last light

1.goRes: She kisses him as though she's apologizing, and then not. When she pulls back she's laughing, eyes wet.
1.waitRes: "You'd wait." Nozomi wipes her eyes, laughing. "That's exactly the problem. I'm going to fall harder."

2.title: Arm's Length
2.text: Nozomi is sitting on the garden wall when Sam finds her, knees drawn up. "I measured it once," she says. "The distance I keep. Arm's length. You've crossed it twice this week." She holds her arm out, then lowers it. "I don't want to measure anymore. Could you come closer, and maybe stay closer?" Moths gather at the lantern and the night smells of damp stone and jasmine. Her courage arrives in small, unsteady pieces.

image.comp: sitting on a low garden wall with her knees drawn up, one hand reaching out to him, brave blush
image.setting: garden wall at evening, fireflies and lantern glow

2.goRes: He steps in, inside her arm's length, and she lets her arm fall around his neck. The rest comes shy, hopeful, and entirely sincere.
2.waitRes: "Slow is good," Nozomi says, smiling at her knees. "I'm not sure I'm ready to be brave twice in a day."

3.title: Planted
3.text: Nozomi sits on the edge of Sam's bed in the pale green sundress, hands folded, as if reporting. "I was sent to watch people like you," she says. "I stopped. I told you, and you didn't kick me out." She looks up, wet-eyed and certain. "No more lies. I'd like to stay. Not for a mission, just because I'm in love." The curtains stir and the house is quiet. She has never made anyone this offer without a mission behind it, and the lack of one makes her breathless.

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed in a pale green sundress, hands folded, tearful hopeful smile
image.setting: Sam's bedroom, evening light through the curtains

3.goRes: She falls into him, trusting, tender, and exactly as in love as she said she'd be. It is the first time she has slept without one ear open.
3.wait: "Are you sure? You don't owe me anything."
3.waitRes: "I know," Nozomi says softly. "That's why I want to." She smooths his sleeve. "Not tonight, though. Let me get brave first."

jump.title: Nothing Left to Hide
jump.text: Nozomi catches Sam in the hall during a thunderstorm and tells him, in a rush, that she is not afraid of the storm, only of the thought of him leaving. Lightning flashes. "I fall for people in one afternoon," she says. "I fell for you in one cup of tea. I'm tired of acting like it's not true." Rain hammers the roof and the hall is dark. It is the first time in years she has told the whole truth to anyone, and she is shaking.

image.comp: standing in a dim hallway with lightning behind her, hands clasped, heart on her sleeve
image.setting: upstairs hall during a thunderstorm, rain on a window

jump.go: Tell her it's true for him too
jump.goRes: It tumbles out of her, and out of him, and the thunder covers the rest. Nozomi's smile, afterward, is the lightest he has seen.
jump.waitRes: "All right." She tucks into his side anyway. "I'll wait. But I'm not going anywhere."

1.title: Cold Hands
1.text: Sam finds Yukine on the balcony in the frost she makes without noticing, hair ribbon trembling. "If you're here to ask if I'm lonely, the answer is no," she says, dry as paper. Then, quieter: "You've been standing there ten minutes. If you wish to do something, do it before I change my mind." Snowflakes of frost spiral from her fingers onto the rail and melt almost at once. She does not seem to have noticed, or to care.

image.comp: standing at a balcony railing with frost on her sleeves, imperious sideways look softening
image.setting: moonlit balcony, a dusting of frost on the rail

1.goRes: Her lips are cool and her breath is not. Yukine makes a small, entirely undignified noise, and the frost melts under her palm.
1.waitRes: "As you wish." Her voice is a blade, her ears pink. "I won't ask twice. Probably. Do not make me regret it."

2.title: Ice Princess
2.text: Yukine summons Sam to her office, closes the door, and says, as if issuing orders, "Sit." Then she sits in his lap. "It's a contingency," she says. "I've been told I'm too cold to touch. I want the data." Her fingers are cool on his collar. "I intend to find out how long it takes you to warm me up." The lamp is low and the ledgers are neat, and she is entirely too composed, except for the pulse he can feel at her wrist.

image.comp: sitting poised on his lap with one hand on his collar, haughty expression undermined by a flush
image.setting: madame's office at night, a ledger and a single lamp

2.goRes: It takes considerably less time than she predicted. Yukine's composure melts one glacial inch at a time.
2.waitRes: "Hmph." Yukine stands, smoothing her hair. "Annoyingly kind. I'll return to you with a revised hypothesis."

3.title: Thaw
3.text: Yukine's room is cold when Sam arrives, frost flowering on the window, and she is sitting on the bed in her white silk, hair ribbon undone. "When my people left home, I told them I would never again be weak," she says quietly. "This is not weakness. I decided. I'd like you to stay." The frost recedes from the glass as she says it. Her breath smokes faintly in the cold room. She sits straight as a blade, yet her hands are clasped tight, and she meets his eyes without a flicker of her old haughtiness.

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed in white silk, ribbon undone and near-black hair spilling, quietly resolute
image.setting: her cold bedroom, frost on the window, a single lamp

3.goRes: Frost clears from the window as the night warms. She sleeps pressed to him, the Ice Princess who finally gave herself permission.
3.wait: "You don't have to be strong in here."
3.waitRes: "Don't tell me what I have to do," Yukine says, but her voice shakes with fondness. "Another night. Do not forget."

jump.title: Sharp Tongue
jump.text: After a quarrel with a client over an unpaid bill, Yukine follows Sam to the stairs and says, seething, "You stood beside me." She grabs his hoodie, furious at the tenderness of it. "I hate that I like it. I hate that it's you." She kisses him, hard and grudging, and keeps going. The staircase is steep and narrow, and there is nowhere to run. Her tongue is razor sharp, and so, tonight, is her honesty.

image.comp: gripping his hoodie on a staircase, glaring and flushed, near-black hair sliding over one shoulder
image.setting: staircase landing, lantern light

jump.goRes: Her fury dissolves into something he will not forget for a long time. "Do not tell anyone," she mutters. "I mean it."
jump.waitRes: "I am perfectly cool," Yukine snaps, face scarlet, and stalks upstairs. Her hair ribbon trails behind her like a surrender flag.

1.title: Faster Than Words
1.text: Hana outruns Sam to the pump after a morning sprint, braced on her knees, grinning. "Beat you by eleven seconds." She straightens, red ribbon swinging. "I don't really do kissing. It feels like standing still." The grin falters. "But I stood still beside you, and I liked it. So try it. Quickly, before I run off." Dew shines on the cobbles. For a girl who never stops moving she has stopped dead, tail flicking, with nowhere left to sprint to.

image.comp: leaning on a courtyard pump, flushed from running, ponytail with a red ribbon, hesitant daring grin
image.setting: courtyard at dawn, a stone pump and dew on cobbles

1.goRes: It's quick, and then it isn't. Hana forgets to run. Her tail flicks wildly and her ears flatten with surprise.
1.waitRes: "You're on!" And she's gone, a streak of red, calling over her shoulder, "Loser kisses the winner!"

2.title: Sparring Partner
2.text: Hana tackles Sam into the sparring-room mats, then pins him with a knee and a laugh. "You're losing," she says. "Give up?" He doesn't. She stays there, panting, ears twitching. "I'm actually terrible at this part," she admits. "The part after I win. What do I do with you?" Dust drifts in the morning sun and the mats are still warm. She has beaten everyone in the house and is completely at a loss for what to do with a win.

image.comp: pinning him lightly on a training mat, ears twitching, breathless, competitive grin turning soft
image.setting: training room with straw mats and wooden swords on the wall

2.goRes: He suggests one. Hana goes quiet, then fiercely curious, and the training room is very quiet for a while.
2.waitRes: "Rematch!" Hana whoops, rolling off. "You're on. Winner picks the next thing. I intend to win."

3.title: Finish Line
3.text: Hana runs the roofline every night, and tonight she runs it straight to Sam's window. She comes in with the night wind, red ribbon in her hand. "It was my cousin's," she says, breathless. "I've never untied it for anyone." The ribbon dangles from her fingers. "I want you to hold it. I'm done racing tonight." Wind pours in through the window and the whole room smells of rain and cut grass. Even her restless tail has gone still.

image.comp: standing in a moonlit window with a red ribbon held out in her palm, hair down, wild tender grin
image.setting: Sam's bedroom window, night wind and moonlight

3.goRes: He takes it, and the fastest girl in any room slows down for him, her laughter low and breathless against his shoulder.
3.waitRes: "Ha. I'm sure." Hana ties the ribbon back, grinning. "But you can have a head start. Catch me next time."

jump.title: Track Record
jump.text: Sam times her morning sprint, and she beats her own record, and swoops him off his feet in a whooping spin. "You're my lucky charm!" She sets him down and sees his face and goes still. "Oh," she says. "That's the reason, isn't it. Every record I've broken lately." She leans in. "Mind if I try something fast?" The courtyard is empty and the sun is climbing. She has outrun every opponent she has ever faced, and cannot outrun this.

image.comp: swinging him around in a courtyard, laughing, ears pricked, then abruptly softer, eyes locked on his
image.setting: courtyard at dawn, morning light

jump.goRes: She is fast about it, and then not fast at all, and every record she's ever set is forgotten.
jump.waitRes: "Slower," Hana says, as if tasting the word. "I can try. Don't laugh if I'm bad at it."

1.title: Quiet Hours
1.text: Shiori is stacking cartridges in her old proctor's harness at midnight, sleeves rolled, lamp low. "I don't sleep well," she says without looking up. "I thought you'd know." The room is very quiet. "My husband used to sit with me like this." She finally meets Sam's eyes. "I haven't wanted anyone to since. I think I do now." The lamp is low and a pot of tea has gone cold. She has not asked anyone to sit with her in a very long time.

image.comp: sitting at a table in a loose dark sweater with silver-white hair over one eye, quiet tired smile
image.setting: her small room at midnight, one lamp and neat gear on a shelf

1.goRes: The kiss is slow and grieved and tender, and she cries a little. She makes no apology, and he does not ask for one.
1.waitRes: "No," Shiori says, with gentle gratitude. "I've learned there never is. Thank you."

2.title: Contingency Plans
2.text: Shiori has a plan for tonight. It is written in her tight proctor's hand and tucked in the cuff of her sweater. "I am too old to be shy," she says, and blushes anyway. "Item four says I should let you take off my sweater. I wasn't sure I'd manage it." She lifts her arms, slowly, a woman daring to want something again. The pages in her cuff are neat as a proctor's. Her usual cool composure holds exactly as long as the sweater does.

image.comp: lifting her arms to tug at a loose dark sweater, silver-white hair messy, nervous wry smile
image.setting: her room, lamplight, a folded note on the table

2.goRes: The sweater goes, and with it a little of the weight she's carried. She laughs, a rusty and surprised sound.
2.wait: "We don't have to follow the plan."
2.waitRes: "Good," Shiori exhales. "I would prefer to revise it." She tucks the note away. "Thank you."

3.title: A Little Light
3.text: Shiori comes to Sam's door in the morning light, not night, hair brushed, wearing the proctor's uniform she hasn't touched in years. "I wanted to be myself when I asked." Her voice cracks only slightly. "I lost two people in one war. I did not think there would be room for a third. There is. Will you have me?" Morning light slants across the floorboards, pale and forgiving. She has pinned back her silver-white hair and for once does not hide the left eye.

image.comp: standing in a doorway in a dark high-collared uniform with her hair neatly brushed back, brave and vulnerable
image.setting: Sam's bedroom doorway in soft morning light

3.goRes: He does. They take the whole morning, and when she lies against him afterward she says, to the ceiling, "Thank you," and means it for everything.
3.waitRes: "I've had time," Shiori says, and smiles sadly. "But I understand. I'll come back. I'm patient."

jump.title: Overdue
jump.text: The anniversary comes and goes, and Shiori stays in the courtyard long after the lanterns are out. Sam sits beside her without a word. Eventually she says, "I thought I was finished." She turns, hair silver in the moonlight. "I'm not. Show me I'm not." She takes his hand in both of hers and kisses it, then his mouth. A last paper lantern gutters out. She is a woman who plans for everything, and she has no plan for this, and she walks in anyway.

image.comp: sitting on a stone bench in moonlight holding his hand in both of hers, silver-white hair loose, tearful, resolute
image.setting: courtyard bench at night, paper lanterns burned low

jump.goRes: He does. Gently, and then with some surprise from them both, he does.
jump.wait: "Are you sure it's me you need right now?"
jump.waitRes: "I'm sure it's you I want," Shiori says. "But you're right to ask. Let me be sure of the rest."

1.title: Field Study
1.text: Tsubasa has labelled Sam's visits to the bathhouse in a clipboard. "Objective measures," she says, adjusting her glasses. "Heart rate, skin temperature, a certain restlessness around me." She puts the clipboard down. "I don't generally enjoy kissing, but I'm a researcher. Hypothesis: it's different with you. May I test it?" Steam fogs the window and a kettle sings in the corner. She is the calmest-looking woman in the house and the most thoroughly flustered.

image.comp: adjusting her rectangular glasses with a clipboard held to her chest, composed with a blush rising
image.setting: bathhouse office, steam on a window, neat shelves

1.goRes: She kisses like a graduate student at a final exam, meticulous, then distracted. "Hypothesis," she breathes, "confirmed. Repeat trials required."
1.waitRes: "I'm both peers." Tsubasa smiles, flustered, and writes something down. "Next week, then. Trial two."

2.title: Hygienic
2.text: Tsubasa scrubs her hands twice, a habit, before she takes Sam's. "I am extremely hygienic," she says, in the voice of someone who has been teased about it. "I realize it's unromantic." Her fingers shake the slightest bit. "I'd like to learn something new, and I'd like you to teach me. Slowly. Clean." Soap, linen and a hint of lavender scent the little room. Her hands are warm from the water, and her curiosity is plain.

image.comp: holding out freshly washed hands with a nervous gentle smile, glasses slightly fogged from steam
image.setting: bathhouse changing room, fresh towels stacked, lantern light

2.goRes: She is the best student he has ever had, curious and diligent, and thoroughly, happily pink. "Notes later," she says, breathless.
2.waitRes: "Reading assignment, then." Tsubasa nods, dignified. "I'll bring questions. Please be prepared."

3.title: Lab Coat Off
3.text: Tsubasa takes off the white coat and folds it over a chair, and then her glasses, which she sets on top with enormous care. "I can't see very well without them," she admits, squinting at Sam's blurry shape. "I'd like to make an exception. For you, I want to be unobserved. Only felt." She has placed the glasses where she can reach them in the morning, and a spare towel just in case. Even her nerves are tidy.

image.comp: sitting on a bed without her glasses, squinting gently, lab coat folded over a nearby chair, shy fond smile
image.setting: her room, a neat bed, a lamp turned low

3.goRes: He does, and she reaches for him by touch, quiet and sure and hilariously unguarded. It is a good night, and it ends with her asleep with a book on her chest.
3.waitRes: "You can wait." Tsubasa puts her glasses back on, flushed. "I just won't be able to read a thing in the meantime."

jump.title: Out of Order
jump.text: Tsubasa gets steam in her glasses and walks into Sam, then stays there, pressing her palms to his chest to steady herself. "I'm not hurt," she says, flustered. "I'm just very warm. I have been for weeks." The glasses fog completely. She takes them off and says, "I'll do the experiment first, and review afterward." The corridor is thick with steam, tiles slick underfoot. Every rule she has about cleanliness and caution has quietly left the building.

image.comp: pressed close to him with fogged glasses held in one hand, flushed and wide-eyed
image.setting: bathhouse corridor, rolling steam and tiled walls

jump.goRes: Steam rolls over them, and no one in the world could write this up.
jump.waitRes: "Practical," Tsubasa laughs, wiping her glasses. "A good researcher cleans her equipment. Give me ten minutes."

1.title: What She Hears
1.text: Kotone is on the landing before Sam reaches the top step. "Your heartbeat changes when you're nervous," she says, blindfold turned toward him, smiling. "It's been doing that all week, near me." She lifts her fingertips to his jaw, finding his face by touch. "I can read the house, Sam. I can't read what you want. Tell me." A warm lantern hangs by the stair, and she tilts toward it as if feeling the heat. Her smile is calm, her breath not at all.

image.comp: standing at the top of the stairs with her blindfold toward him, fingertips raised to touch his jaw, soft knowing smile
image.setting: upstairs landing at dusk, lantern light on a worn banister

1.goRes: He kisses her, and she gasps, delighted. "Oh, that," Kotone whispers. "That I can feel all the way through."
1.waitRes: "Say it, then." She listens with her whole body for a long moment. "Mm. I'll wait to hear the rest."

2.title: Map by Touch
2.text: Kotone draws Sam's face with her fingers the way she maps a room: forehead, brow, the line of his mouth. "I've known you by sound and chakra for months," she says, voice steady, cheeks warm. "I'd like to know you the other way. All of it, if you'll let me." Her hand slides down his collar, deliberate and curious. The rugs are soft underfoot and the room smells of cedar. She knows exactly where everything stands, and chooses to risk the unfamiliar anyway.

image.comp: seated close to him with the blindfold on, fingertips tracing his collar, rapt gentle smile
image.setting: her quiet room, soft rugs, a lamp she can't see but likes warm

2.goRes: She learns him with exquisite attention, and he learns how it feels to be known entirely by someone who cannot see him and knows him anyway.
2.waitRes: "I'd like that." Kotone presses her palm over his heart, listening. "Faster than I thought, though, isn't it? You answer for yourself."

3.title: Quarter Note
3.text: Kotone sets the blindfold on the nightstand for the first time in front of anyone. The metal plate rings softly against wood. "I don't need it off," she says. "But I'd like to be someone you can see." Her sightless eyes are warm brown, and fixed unerringly on his. "Stay. I'll hear you stay." The room is dark, which she cannot see and he can, and she tells him so with a laugh. The metal plate rests on the wood with a quiet chime.

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed with her blindfold set aside, calm unfocused eyes turned toward him, tender smile
image.setting: her bedroom, a soft lamp, a blindfold with a note-plate on the nightstand

3.goRes: He stays, and the night is gentle and unhurried and full of listening, her laugh at every sound he makes.
3.wait: "You don't have to take it off for me."
3.waitRes: "I know," Kotone says warmly, and picks up the blindfold. "I chose to. Ask again soon. I'll be listening."

jump.title: Heard It Coming
jump.text: Kotone halts mid-hall, tilts her head, and says, "Your heart is racing." She turns toward him. "Mine is too, apparently. I can hear the difference between lies and wanting, and you are in the second category." She crosses to him in three sure steps and finds his collar. "I'm tired of being polite about it." The lantern sways, the floorboards creak, and she has heard every beat of his pulse for ten minutes without once mentioning it.

image.comp: standing in a hallway with her head tilted, blindfold facing him, hand reaching unerringly for his collar, amused and flushed
image.setting: upstairs hallway, a lantern swinging lightly

jump.goRes: She isn't. For someone who senses everyone, the surprise is all hers, and she laughs against his mouth.
jump.waitRes: "I am listening." Kotone grins. "You are very loud. Come find me when you've decided."

1.title: Clone Council
1.text: Three Tobaris are crowded onto the back step when Sam opens the door. "We voted," says one. "Four to one," says another. "She's the one who objects," says the third, pointing at the real one, who is bright red. "Fine," Tobari mutters. "I don't do kissing. But they say I have to try it once. With you." The clones vanish in a puff of smoke. Somewhere in the garden a dozen quiet whispers are shushed at once. She stands rigid, the fur collar tickling her flushed jaw.

image.comp: standing stiffly on a back step with a small white fur collar and arms folded, red eyes avoiding his, blushing
image.setting: back step at night, small puffs of smoke fading

1.goRes: She is stiff, then she isn't. "...Huh," Tobari says. A faint voice from the smoke: "Told you."
1.waitRes: "They never ask," Tobari sighs, rubbing her face. "They decide. Thanks for asking. I'll think about it."

2.title: Strong Preferences
2.text: Tobari has drawn a diagram on a roll of paper and is explaining it with her ears red. "Hana thinks I should be bolder. My clones think I should be quieter. I think I should be on my hands and knees," she blurts, then covers her mouth. "I meant, I have preferences. Strong ones. I'd like to try them. If you'd like to see." Lamp oil, ink and the smell of old scrolls fill the room. She has drawn arrows on the diagram and then crossed them out, blushing furiously.

image.comp: kneeling by a scroll of diagrams with a hand over her mouth, short white ponytail, red eyes huge with embarrassment
image.setting: her room, scrolls and a low lamp

2.goRes: Her clones knock politely on the wall, and Tobari yells at them to go away. After that it is a quiet, flustered, wonderful hour.
2.waitRes: "Fine!" Tobari buries her face in the scroll. "I'll refine the diagram."

3.title: No Clones
3.text: Tobari stands at Sam's door with nobody behind her. "I sent them to cover the doors." Her voice cracks. "All of them. I needed to do this alone. They can't be in the room, they know too much." The white fur collar is askew. "I like you. I've liked you for ages. Let me in before I put on a bodyguard." The corridor beyond her is eerily empty, every clone dispatched, every door doubly guarded. The only person left to be brave is her.

image.comp: standing at a bedroom door alone, fur collar slightly crooked, red eyes shy and brave
image.setting: Sam's bedroom doorway, lamplight and a quiet hallway behind her

3.goRes: It's gentle. For the first time her chakra is quiet, entirely hers, and she falls asleep smiling. Somewhere in the house, a dozen Tobaris all sigh at once.
3.wait: "Are you sure? They won't like it."
3.waitRes: "They'll survive." Tobari lifts her chin. "I'll try again tomorrow, with maybe two clones. And a hammock."

jump.title: Unmasked by Clone
jump.text: A clone, in the middle of a security shift, announces loudly to the whole kitchen: "She likes Sam! She said it in the bath!" The real Tobari arrives in a dead run, smoke trailing, and stops dead when she sees Sam. "Okay," she pants. "Okay. That's out. Fine. Kiss me and I'll never stop being embarrassed." A bowl rolls across the floor, smoke still drifting from where the clone vanished, and she cannot meet his eye or look away.

image.comp: breathless in a kitchen doorway with smoke trailing behind, ponytail wild, red eyes locked on his in dismay and resolve
image.setting: kitchen, a cloud of smoke and a spilled bowl

jump.goRes: She makes a strangled noise, grabs his hoodie, and stays there. The clone, somewhere, hums approvingly.
jump.waitRes: "I'm going to murder her." Tobari stomps off. At the door she whirls. "But it's true, okay? Remember that!"

1.title: Hem and Heart
1.text: Marina kneels at Sam's feet with pins in her mouth, adjusting the hem of a coat. She removes them carefully. "I mend every dress in this house," she says, curls bobbing, "but yours is the only seam I keep pretending to fix." She looks up, pale blue eyes sly. "There's nothing wrong with it, you know. I wanted the excuse." A pale dress form stands behind her in the lamplight, with a row of dolls on the shelf pretending very hard not to look.

image.comp: kneeling at his feet with a pin cushion on her wrist, pale ringlets framing a sly blush
image.setting: sewing room, fabric bolts and dolls on a shelf

1.go: Lift her to her feet and kiss her
1.goRes: She tastes like tea and thread. A doll on the shelf falls over in surprise, and Marina laughs into his shoulder.
1.waitRes: "They are completely unrelated to anyone," Marina says brightly. "Nobody you know. Another day, then."

2.title: Fitting
2.text: Marina insists on a private fitting. The door locks. She runs the measuring tape across his shoulders, down his arm, around his waist, and her breath catches when it reaches his collar. "I'm quite fond of measuring," she says, almost to herself. "I've measured you in my head for months. Let me check my work properly." Bolts of cloth and pins in neat rows line the walls. She has locked the door twice and tested the handle, just in case.

image.comp: standing close with a measuring tape looped round her neck and her hands on his shoulders, pale blue eyes bright
image.setting: private sewing room, mirror, spools of thread and lantern light

2.goRes: Her work, it turns out, was excellent. Marina applies every careful, creative technique, and the dolls watch in silent approval.
2.waitRes: "Of course, of course." Marina snips a thread, unabashed. "I'll finish the coat. And the rest can be finished too. Tomorrow."

3.title: Night Owl
3.text: The sewing room light is still on at three. Marina has finished the coat, and she holds it up for him, perfectly tailored. "It's a thank-you," she says, bashful. "For letting me be strange." She sets it down, and slips her fingers through his. "The dolls will behave. I'd like to show you the rest of my night." A pot of cold tea sits beside a dress half finished. The dolls on the shelf are facing the wall, which she insists is a coincidence.

image.comp: standing in a lamp-lit sewing room holding a finished coat out to him, curls loose, tender conspiratorial smile
image.setting: the sewing room at 3am, dolls on a shelf, a single lamp

3.goRes: She leads him, and the night is soft and quiet and unfolds like a thing well stitched. The dolls, to her great pride, behave.
3.wait: "Tell me it's not just the coat."
3.waitRes: "It isn't the coat," Marina says, with a delighted laugh. "But that is the sweetest thing anyone has asked. Ask again soon."

jump.title: Loose Thread
jump.text: A seam gives way at the worst moment: Sam's cloak snags, and Marina, nearby, steadies him with a hand to his chest. They stay there longer than the thread requires. "You keep unravelling," she says, breathless. "I would like to be the one to mend it. And then, perhaps, to unravel it again." A bright thread dangles from his cuff, and she has not looked away from his face in a good three breaths.

image.comp: holding a bit of thread, one hand against his chest, pale blue eyes sly and flushed
image.setting: hallway outside the sewing room, a snagged cloak

jump.goRes: She mends him, and then does the other thing too, with surprising eagerness for a woman who works with dolls.
jump.waitRes: "The cloak!" Marina laughs. "Yes. I'm a professional. After that, I'm free."

1.title: Order Up
1.text: Ayano slides Sam his usual before he's even sat, extra spice, just how he likes it. "I know everyone's order," she says cheerfully, "and everybody's secret. Yours is the only one I haven't said out loud." She leans across the counter. "You've been looking at my mouth the whole time you ate. So let me serve you something else." A last wisp of steam curls from his empty bowl. She has been watching him over the rim of her ladle for a while, and has finally decided to say so.

image.comp: leaning on a kitchen bar counter with a ladle in one hand, long ponytail swinging, teasing warm grin
image.setting: kitchen bar at closing, steaming bowls and lantern light

1.goRes: She's laughing before he's finished kissing her, and then not laughing at all. "Extra spice," Ayano whispers. "Told you."
1.waitRes: "Ha! Finish it, then." Ayano takes the empty bowl away. "I'm not going anywhere. I always know where you are."

2.title: Kitchen After Hours
2.text: The last bowl is washed. Ayano dries her hands slowly, then steps behind Sam and slides her arms around his waist. "I know the whole house," she says into his back. "Nobody knows me. I like how it feels, you looking." Her hands drift down, practiced and warm. "Want to know what I can do with these? It isn't ramen." The pots are scrubbed and the lamps turned low. She has the kind of calm that comes from knowing everyone else's secrets and finally surrendering her own.

image.comp: standing behind him with her arms wrapped around his waist, chin on his shoulder, cheeky smile
image.setting: kitchen bar after hours, steam fading, clean bowls stacked

2.goRes: He does, and she makes sure he never regrets it. Ayano is generous, attentive, and cheerful to the end.
2.waitRes: "Pfft. You're no fun." Ayano flicks a towel at him. "I'll accept an upstairs. I know all the creaky stairs, so I'll be quiet."

3.title: Last Customer
3.text: Ayano locks the kitchen door and hangs the sign. "You're my last customer," she says, and for once the cheerful mask slips. "Everyone tells me their troubles. I never get to tell mine." She sits on the counter, ponytail down, and pats the spot beside her. "Stay? I'd like someone to listen. And then, if you're willing, someone to hold me." A single bowl sits cooling between them, the first she has ever left uneaten. The night has gone quiet, and she lets it.

image.comp: sitting on a counter with her ponytail loose, warm tired smile, one hand patting the space beside her
image.setting: kitchen at night, the sign turned, a single bowl steaming

3.goRes: He listens, and listens, and then holds her. The night continues upstairs, where she is finally the one being cared for.
3.wait: "Are you sure you want more than listening?"
3.waitRes: "Listening is lovely," Ayano says, leaning on him. "Let's start there. The rest will keep."

jump.title: On the House
jump.text: A regular wanders in and pronounces Ayano's cooking the secret to Sam's good mood. She smacks him with a towel and bolts into the pantry with Sam, mortified and giggling. "I know everything about everyone," she whispers. "I can't keep my own heart a secret from you. Sam. Kiss me before I make another joke." Flour hangs in the air, and from outside the door comes a faint indignant demand for noodles. She does not appear to hear it.

image.comp: hiding in a pantry with a towel over her shoulder, ponytail swinging, giggling and flushed, one hand gripping his sleeve
image.setting: pantry shelves, sacks of flour and jars

jump.goRes: She melts into it, still laughing. The regular outside shouts for noodles, and no one answers.
jump.waitRes: "He can wait." Ayano grins. "But so can this. You owe me a kiss, mister."

1.title: Strands
1.text: Kamiko trims the ragged edge of her hair with a blade at her hip, as she does every year, and Sam walks in just as the cut strand floats down. "Don't," she says calmly, steel in it. Then, softer: "I only keep a few people close enough to see this. I did not intend to add one." She lifts her chin. "I don't kiss. I've decided to make an exception." A single strand of black hair drifts slowly to the floor between them, unnoticed. She sheathes the blade with a small, controlled click.

image.comp: standing before a mirror with her long black hair uneven at the end, blade at her hip, composed sharp face with a flicker of nerves
image.setting: a quiet dressing room, a single mirror and lantern glow

1.goRes: Her control holds for exactly three seconds. Then Kamiko, endlessly patient, kisses him as if she's finally run out.
1.waitRes: "I have endless patience," Kamiko says coolly, and sheathes the blade. "Right up until I don't. Be warned."

2.title: Patience Runs Out
2.text: Kamiko has been polishing a glass for ten minutes. Sam has been drinking for ten minutes. Finally she sets it down and says, "I have endless patience. I have had it. You are slow." She takes the cup from his hand, sets it on the bar, and steps into him. "I will not ask twice." Her hair brushes his wrist like silk thread. The lounge is silent. She has a way of holding still that makes a room hold its breath, and she is holding it now.

image.comp: standing close behind a bar with her arms crossed, sharp composed face cracking into a hungry smile
image.setting: lounge bar, empty glasses and lantern light

2.goRes: She doesn't. Kamiko is polished and certain and, to her mild irritation, completely undone for a while.
2.wait: "I wanted to be sure you were ready."
2.waitRes: "I am the readiest I will ever be," Kamiko says through her teeth. "But fine. A day, Sam. Not a week."

3.title: Uneven Edge
3.text: Kamiko lets down the full length of her hair across Sam's pillow, black as ink, uneven and wild at the bottom. "I cut it each time I lose something," she says quietly. "It is very uneven." She glances up. "You're not shorter than an inch of it. I haven't cut since I met you." She smiles, small and honest. "Stay with me." Moonlight lies across the sheets in a long pale stripe. She has put her blade out of reach, which tells him more than anything she says.

image.comp: lying back against pillows with her long uneven black hair spread across them, small honest smile
image.setting: Sam's bedroom, sheets, a lamp turned low

3.goRes: The cool, unflappable spirit is warm, in the end, and unhurried. The blade rests unused on the nightstand all night.
3.waitRes: "Do not make me answer that twice." Kamiko's smile is dry. "But yes. I'll wait. Briefly."

jump.title: Unflappable, Mostly
jump.text: A drunk guest insults the house, and Kamiko dispatches him with two quiet sentences and a single strand of hair around his collar. Afterward she turns on Sam, breathing hard. "You looked afraid for me." Her voice is dangerous. "No one has done that in a century." She grabs his hoodie and the polish drops from her entirely. A broken glass glitters on the floor and the guest's footsteps fade. The woman who never loses her temper is struggling very visibly to keep it.

image.comp: holding his hoodie in one fist, black hair swinging, sharp face flushed with sudden intensity
image.setting: corridor outside the lounge, a toppled chair behind her

jump.goRes: The Kamiko he meets then is not polished at all. It is everything she hasn't said, in a rush.
jump.waitRes: "I am breathing." Kamiko lets go, smooths her hair, and walks away with absolute dignity. "Ask me again in an hour."

1.title: Friendliest in the House
1.text: Nai drapes herself across the sofa beside Sam, black hair pooling, and smiles in her pleasant way. "Everyone says my eyes are ominous. You never flinched." Her eyes go matte black as she looks at him, and nothing happens, and she laughs, delighted. "Still you. Nothing to cancel. Kiss me, then? Night owl hours are lonely." Only one lantern still burns, and the shadows pool darkly in the corners. Her smile is the warmest thing in the room.

image.comp: lounging along a sofa with her long black hair pooled, eyes turned matte black, pleasant lazy smile
image.setting: lounge couch late at night, lantern glow

1.goRes: Soft and slow and utterly unhurried. "Mm," Nai hums. "The jutsu is cancelled but this stays."
1.waitRes: "Tomorrow's fine." Nai yawns happily. "I'm up all night anyway. Wake me when you're brave."

2.title: Void
2.text: Nai slides into Sam's lap on the lounge couch as if it's her own, and tilts his chin up. "I'm told I'm a good listener," she says. "With my mouth, mostly. I've been wondering what you'd think." Her eyes stay warm for him, never black. "Nobody's watching. Let me be friendly." Rain taps at the curtain and the clock has stopped mattering. She is, as always, friendly, and tonight a little shy about it.

image.comp: sitting in his lap with a calm pleasant smile, long black hair swept over one shoulder, eyes warm
image.setting: empty lounge at 2am, a single lamp and a drawn curtain

2.goRes: She is friendly in every sense, cheerful and generous and in no hurry whatsoever. The night owl keeps her hours.
2.waitRes: "Slow is my specialty," Nai says, pleased, and snuggles in. "We can start with a nap."

3.title: Eyes Open
3.text: Nai turns off the lantern and doesn't turn it on again. "I look at people hard when I'm afraid," she says in the dark. "They get scared of me. You don't." Her voice is gentle. "I'd like to look at you, properly, and not be afraid. Stay with me until morning. I'm good at mornings. Late ones." Her room is lit by a single dim lamp, and now by none. She keeps her eyes steadily warm for him, a gift she does not give often.

image.comp: in bed with the covers pulled to her shoulders, black hair on the pillow, eyes soft and warm, relaxed smile
image.setting: her bedroom, the lantern low, rumpled sheets

3.goRes: The night is slow, and then not, and then slow again. When the eyes finally close, they are not black, only warm, and so sleepy.
3.waitRes: "A bit." Nai smiles, unbothered. "But I'm better at nervous when you're nearby. Soon."

jump.title: Too Pleasant
jump.text: Sam catches Nai shaking out a client's poker deck at dawn, caught cheating, and she smiles so pleasantly the client leaves. "You're laughing," she says. "Everyone else is afraid." She sets down the cards. "You are a lovely person, Sam. I haven't been pleasant to someone in a long time. May I be?" The first light of morning pools on the green baize. Her smile is its usual pleasant self, and her eyes, for him, are gentle.

image.comp: standing at a card table in early light, eyes briefly black then warm, mischievous pleasant smile
image.setting: lounge card table at dawn, scattered cards

jump.goRes: She is very pleasant indeed. The sun comes up on the two of them, and nobody notices the clock.
jump.waitRes: "Pfft. Breakfast and then." Nai takes his arm. "I'll cook. Don't tell the others I can."

1.title: Itinerary
1.text: Ebina hands Sam a laminated schedule titled Free Time, with a block at nine marked simply: Sam. "I plan everything," she says, bandanna low over her brow, face as flat as ever. "This I did not plan. It happened on page forty of a very good book." She slides closer. "I read about this a lot. I'd like to compare notes." A pen sits capped on the desk, an unusual sight. Her face is perfectly still, but her bandanna has crept down toward her brow.

image.comp: holding a laminated schedule against her chest, dark bandanna low over her brow, strong brows raised, hint of a smile
image.setting: her room, shelves of novels and a tidy desk

1.goRes: She's more nervous than she lets on and kisses well anyway, as if trying to reproduce a favourite paragraph. "Chapter one," she murmurs, "done."
1.waitRes: "Scheduled." Ebina writes it in, serious as a vow. "Nine on Thursday."

2.title: Reading Ahead
2.text: Ebina has a stack of romance novels with Sam's name taped to the spines. She holds one up, bright red under the bandanna. "These are fiction," she says. "I've been told the realistic parts are exaggerated. I would like to check." She tugs her shirt hem and, without a moment of shame, begins to show him exactly how much she has learned. Dog-eared pages and bookmarks litter the floor. She has not once covered her eyes, though she has not looked at him either.

image.comp: sitting among stacked novels with a bandanna on, strong brows arched, bold blush, hands on her hem
image.setting: her room, a tidy stack of novels and a low lamp

2.goRes: He agrees, with gusto. Ebina's performance is, to his surprise, entirely sincere, and the books slide to the floor.
2.waitRes: "Fair." Ebina squares the stack. "I'll reread. Page three hundred. See you then."

3.title: Without the Shades
3.text: Ebina sits across the bed from Sam, round black sunglasses in her hands. "I haven't let anyone see my eyes in years," she says, wry and steady. "It started as a joke." She takes a breath. "I'd like you to see them. Please don't say anything clever." The glasses come off. She looks up, dark and unguarded. Her novels line the wall behind her like an audience. For once she has nothing to read, and no plan, and she looks small and brave.

image.comp: sitting on a bed holding round black sunglasses in her lap, dark eyes uncovered and shy, bandanna still in place
image.setting: her bedroom, lamplight, a novel splayed on the nightstand

3.goRes: He says nothing. He just looks at her, and the rest of the night proves better than any book she owns.
3.waitRes: "I'll keep the glasses a little longer." Ebina sets them on the nightstand anyway. "But I've shown you. That's a first."

jump.title: Plot Twist
jump.text: Ebina is in the middle of a chapter in the garden when Sam sits down, and the book falls from her hands. "This isn't in the outline," she says, flat but flushed. "I'm not good with unscheduled things. I'd like to make an exception, right now, before I overthink it." She kisses him, quick and unplanned, and then goes bright red. A page flutters in the breeze and the bench creaks. She has re-read this scene a hundred times, and nothing prepared her for it.

image.comp: in a garden chair with a novel dropped in her lap, bandanna low, red-faced after an impulsive kiss
image.setting: garden bench, afternoon light through leaves

jump.goRes: The itinerary never recovers. Ebina leans against him, laughing quietly, and doesn't schedule anything else.
jump.waitRes: "Pencil." Ebina nods solemnly. "Pencil is acceptable. I'll bring an eraser."

1.title: Rooftop Wind
1.text: Lyn's patrol ends on the roof, where the wind comes straight off the plains road and she can finally breathe. Sam climbs up with two mugs of tea. "Four walls make me itchy," she admits, leaning on the chimney. "Funny. You're the first thing in this town that doesn't." She hasn't stopped watching him since he sat down. Below them the town hums, and her hand rests near his on the tiles, close enough that neither mentions it.

image.comp: leaning against a chimney with her ponytail whipping in the wind, a sideways grin, mug in hand
image.setting: rooftop of the house at dusk, the town's lantern-lit roofs below

1.goRes: She tastes of tea and open sky. When she laughs against his mouth it sounds a lot like a challenge accepted.
1.waitRes: "Careful is for people who lose." She bumps his shoulder, grinning, and goes back to watching the road, a little pink around the ears.

2.title: Sparring Rematch
2.text: Lyn drags Sam to the yard behind the stables for a lesson with practice swords, which he loses in four seconds. She pins his wooden blade under her boot, breathing hard, flushed and pleased. "Ha! Again?" Then she sees how close they are, and the grin shifts into something quieter. "...Or we could call it a draw." A few stable cats watch from the rail, deeply unimpressed. Her sword arm is steady, but her pulse in her throat is not.

image.comp: standing over him with a practice sword, flushed and breathless, a confident smile softening
image.setting: stable yard behind the house in late afternoon light, straw and training dummies

2.goRes: She drops the sword in the straw and pulls him up by both hands. The rest of the lesson is not about swordplay, and Lyn is every bit as competitive about it.
2.waitRes: "Coward." But she's laughing, and she tosses him a towel. "Fine. I'll win the next two and then we'll talk terms."

3.title: Out of the Rain
3.text: A storm drives Lyn off the roof for the first time. She turns up at Sam's door soaked to the skin, scowling at the ceiling like it's a personal insult. "Don't say anything. I'm not used to sleeping under a lid." She hovers, dripping, and then, quietly, "I'd rather not do it alone tonight." Thunder rattles the shutters again, and she flinches, then scowls at herself for it. A dripping puddle spreads under her boots.

image.comp: standing in a doorway wet from rain, green ponytail dripping, awkward but earnest expression
image.setting: Sam's bedroom with a small fire lit, rain streaming down the window

3.goRes: He wraps a blanket around her shoulders, and for once she doesn't argue. Somewhere between the thunder and the dark, the lid stops bothering her.
3.waitRes: "Right. Practical." She huffs, but she's smiling. "I'll hang my cloak by the fire. Don't think this means I'm leaving."

jump.title: Overdue Challenge
